title: Urban Basketball Sneaker Poster Design
content: Create an ultra-premium street basketball sneaker advertising poster for an original brand called VANTAGE X, designed as a Cannes-level key visual that fuses luxury product photography, aggressive black-ink sports illustration, and explosive urban editorial typography. Preserve the exact core structure and camera logic of the image: one monumental hyper-real high-top basketball sneaker dominates the lower foreground in an extreme low-angle perspective, while a giant hand-drawn basketball player erupts across the upper background in a violent forward-driving action pose. The final image must now combine stronger Orbit impact, tighter Transit system control, and bolder Port-level concept integration, so the shoe feels like the source of all motion, power, and graphic force in the poster. Core composition: Use a tall vertical poster with one oversized sneaker in the lower-left to lower-center foreground, pushed slightly closer to the viewer for greater visual pressure. The toe box, side emblem, collar, laces, and outsole must feel monumental and tactile, as if the shoe is stepping directly into the viewer’s space. Behind and above it, place one huge black-ink sketch basketball player in an extreme explosive drive, jump, or pre-dunk attack moment, twisting through the frame with sharp momentum. Add one smaller secondary sketched player in the mid-background for layered court rhythm. The shoe must be the first thing seen; the illustrated players act as amplified motion ghosts generated by the shoe’s energy. Orbit impact enhancement: Increase the visual aggression of the foreground shoe. Make the sole impact at the base feel like it detonates the composition through bold black brush bursts, ink spray, fractured motion streaks, and launch-like ground energy. Tighten the distance between camera and shoe so the product feels heavier, closer, and more dominant. The poster must hit instantly with a “one step breaks the frame” sensation. Transit system enhancement: Keep the same skeletal layout, but unify the entire visual language into a mature black-and-white street-illustration system with one controlled hero product color event. The background athlete linework, speed lines, sketch shading, annotation marks, headline typography, secondary text, and impact splashes must all follow one disciplined graphic grammar: consistent ink weight, consistent roughness, consistent motion direction, and coordinated negative-space balance. The whole piece must feel like an official international sports campaign poster, not a collage of separate ideas. Port concept enhancement: Push the concept so the athlete’s motion visibly originates from the sneaker. Let selected ink lines, force strokes, and motion arcs extend from the shoe edges, outsole, and side emblem into the illustrated player’s limbs and trajectory, creating a clear idea that the player’s explosive action is being driven by the sneaker itself. The giant player can be captured in a more extreme airborne breakthrough or pre-slam moment, with the action lines visually tethered back to the shoe. The concept must feel bold and intelligent, not gimmicky. Product design: Design the shoe as a premium globally market-ready high-top street basketball sneaker from VANTAGE X. Use a bold colorway of metallic bronze-gold, matte black, off-white, and subtle silver technical accents. The upper should combine structured leather, engineered support panels, padded ankle protection, reinforced lace wings, sculpted heel geometry, and performance-driven outsole logic. Add an original VANTAGE X emblem on the lateral side. The shoe must feel elite, urban, muscular, and collectible. Material realism: Render the sneaker with exceptional realism and sharp commercial detail. The bronze-gold leather must feel smooth, rich, and premium with controlled highlights. Black areas must feel deep and performance-oriented with distinct texture separation. Show crisp stitching, lace weave, rubber density, sole grip, collar padding, and precise panel edges. The product must feel expensive, durable, and technically believable. Illustration style: Render the players and court world in expressive black ink sketch style with editorial sports aggression: raw contour lines, scratch shading, manga-like force marks, speed streaks, splatter accents, rough court geometry, and brush-impact sweeps. The drawn world should remain powerful but clearly secondary to the shoe. Keep the illustration highly art-directed, not messy. Typography and copy: Add fully original English typography integrated into the composition. Use one powerful headline such as “OWN THE ASPHALT” or “RISE ABOVE IMPACT,” rendered in a sharp custom street-sport editorial style. Add a refined support line such as “Engineered for explosive lift, locked grip, and court-born dominance.” Include a small premium VANTAGE X brand mark. Typography must feel dynamic, urban, aggressive, and compositionally precise. No copied wording, no generic font block. Background and environment: Keep the environment mostly white and minimal, constructed from perspective court lines, urban fragments, black ink slashes, motion scratches, and negative space. Use explosive black brushwork near the shoe base to anchor the product and visually launch the athlete upward. The environment must feel graphic and fast, never cluttered. Lighting: Use premium studio lighting on the sneaker, with soft directional highlights from upper-left and front-left, giving the metallic bronze-gold surfaces a luxurious glow. The illustration can remain flatter and more graphic, but should align with the shoe’s motion and shadow logic. The contrast between hyper-real product lighting and raw ink energy is essential. Color direction: Keep the overall palette tightly controlled: white field, black illustration system, bronze-gold hero product surfaces, black technical components, off-white sole accents, and minimal silver highlights. title: Premium Spirits Packaging Design Proposal Board
content:
Design a professional packaging proposal board for a {argument name="product concept" default="unofficial concept"} {argument name="capacity" default="500ml"} high-end {argument name="flavor profile" default="sauce-aroma"} Chinese spirit (Baijiu). The category is premium spirits/liquor gift packaging, targeting high-net-worth gifting, personal collection, corporate gifts, and business banquets. The sales and transport scenarios include boutique retail display, festival gifting, e-commerce shipping, and secondary outer carton transport. The style is a combination derived from 'Auto Mode': the primary style is traditional heritage craft, supplemented by modern international information hierarchy and modular order, emphasizing brewing techniques, aging, origin culture, and modern premium brand expression, avoiding cliché black-and-gold, red-and-gold, or over-traditional symbols. The core concept is 'Contemporary Expression of Ancient Craftsmanship': using a restrained high-end color palette of kiln brown, rice paper ivory, deep indigo, and oxidized copper accents. The visual has an oriental charm but is not dated, with an international luxury feel that is not cold.
Main packaging uses a vertical rigid gift box structure. Recommended values for prototype: lift-off lid with a neck shoulder structure made of greyboard wrapped in specialty paper, holding one 500ml glass bottle inside. The gift box body is a high-rigidity structure, slender and stable, opening vertically. The inner tray clearly supports the bottle, suitable for luxury display. The bottle is a 500ml transparent or light smoky grey glass bottle, with proportions typical of high-end Baijiu (approx. 280–320 mm height, 85–95 mm diameter, total weight 1.2–1.5 kg). Internal protection must follow glass bottle safety logic: bottom load-bearing support + body stabilization + independent neck control, avoiding stress solely on the cap. The insert should be molded pulp or high-density paper, fitting the bottle contour with specific slots for shoulders and neck, ensuring no movement, glass-on-glass collision, or lid compression during transit. Must clearly distinguish between the main gift box and e-commerce shipping protection, including a B-flute or reinforced corrugated outer shipper with cushioning.
Brand identity and graphics must fit high-end spirits: restrained and recognizable vertical or centered composition. Use conceptual placeholders for names like 'Heritage Collection' and brief English labels like 'SAUCE-AROMA BAIJIU', 'HERITAGE CRAFT', '500 mL'. Text must be minimal and precise. The font style combines oriental calligraphy charm with modern high-end serif/sans-serif typography. Materials should be realistic: specialty paper with fiber texture or rice paper feel, using restrained copper/matte gold foil, embossing, debossing, spot UV, or micro-relief, but only on logos or seals. Abstract brewing tools, fermentation textures, or landscape contours can be used, but must be abstract and high-end, avoiding realistic illustrations or cliché dragon/phoenix symbols.
The board must be a 16:9 landscape composition on a clean white or light warm grey studio background. Place a large main packaging 45° perspective view in the center as the primary focal point (45%–60% of visual). Surround it with 7–9 smaller modular auxiliary views: front/back/side projections, unboxing effect, exploded view of the insert, bottle placement, e-commerce shipper structure, production-intent dieline, material swatches, and labels. Maintain clear professional order without clutter.
Must include a production-intent visualization dieline with professional legend: red for trim, blue dashed for creases, green for bleed, purple for safety, grey for reference, yellow for adhesive, light brown for insert, gold for foil, and bright white for spot UV. Use placeholders for barcodes, QR codes, and regulatory marks. Technical specs include units in mm, 3mm bleed, 5mm safety margin, and standard tolerances, presented as a concept board, not a dense blueprint.
Lighting and rendering must combine hyper-realistic 3D packaging with high-end paper photography. Paper fibers, embossing, corner details, board thickness, and glass reflections must be credible. Use a professional product photography angle, slightly above the table (45° tilt). The overall look is clean, expensive, and award-level, matching top-tier international packaging design standards. Keywords: premium sauce-aroma baijiu packaging proposal board, heritage craft inspired luxury liquor gift box, oversized hero rigid box mockup, molded pulp insert structure, ecommerce protective shipper, production-intent dieline visualization, elegant oriental contemporary packaging, premium Chinese spirits brand concept, tactile specialty paper, realistic emboss and foil details, photorealistic packaging design presentation, clean studio background, ultra detailed, high resolution.

Bold oversized typography in the background with premium editorial branding.

Bottom Left – Cozy Winter Theme: The man presents a coffee cup that opens into a warm wooden cabin with glowing fireplaces, snow-covered pine forests, warm interior lighting, soft snowfall, floating steam, and cozy cinematic atmosphere. Earthy beige and brown color palette with nostalgic premium coffee branding and elegant typography.

Bottom Right – Energy Explosion Theme: The man dynamically leaps beside a coffee cup bursting with colorful coffee splashes, donuts, sprinkles, planets, swirling liquid, glowing particles, neon energy trails, and vibrant orange-pink gradients. Bold oversized typography fills the background, creating a youthful, energetic campaign with playful motion and excitement.

The same man appears in every panel with short textured black hair, neatly trimmed beard and mustache, warm brown eyes, friendly confident smile, wearing outfits matching each theme. title: Explosion Effect Commercial Poster
content: * 压缩中心破裂，锐利外壳断裂。所有爆发集中在产品中段：外壳先出现清晰、厚薄可见的断裂面，再从裂口向外张开，中心才会有“压力瞬间释放”的力量。 * 定向碎片层级，由大到小的放射状扩散。大块巧克力、花生和内馅先围绕爆点做放射状主碎片；外围再接中碎屑和粉尘，不能所有物体等大小、均匀散开。 * 弹性焦糖桥，稀疏的碎屑和发光粉尘。焦糖用拉丝把断裂面和飞出的碎片重新连接，少量可见的小颗粒延续运动方向；既有爆发力，又不会显得凌乱。 为BABY RUTH制作一张顶级商业海报，将“奶云轨道”方向推向极致，同时进一步扩大深色负空间，强化红金对比度，并放大中心爆发的张力。图像必须以一根垂直立于画面正中心的 Baby Ruth 巧克力棒作为绝对主角，完全可见、正面朝前且品牌标识清晰。巧克力棒的中部必须以超写实的爆炸方式炸开，展示出具有极致触感丰富度的烤花生、浓郁焦糖、牛轧糖和破碎的巧克力涂层。最终作品必须显得大胆、令人垂涎、如珠宝般精致、具有电影感且达到收藏级，具备更强的中心压力、更丰富的奢华色彩对比以及更具戏剧性的暗场呈现。仅使用英文品牌元素，活动文字极简，使图像以视觉效果为主导。核心构图：使用高垂直构图，将一根 Baby Ruth 巧克力棒精确放置在中心轴线上，保持直立且完全清晰可见。将爆炸紧密集中在中段，使所有视觉能量从中心向外辐射。进一步扩大周围的黑色空白区域，让核心产品和爆发区域占据更小、更集中的中心地带。构图必须感觉像是一个珍贵的物体在奢华的黑暗中引爆，中心承受着最大的压力。核心产品逻辑：Baby Ruth 巧克力棒必须能被立即且明确地识别为核心产品。保留可辨识的包装纸可见度和品牌层级，同时通过中心破裂以极致写实的方式展示其标志性内馅：厚实的焦糖丝、浓密的烤花生、丰富的牛轧糖核心以及锐利断裂的巧克力外壳。产品必须显得沉重、有质感、诱人且物理真实，仿佛是内部压力将其炸开。奶云轨道增强：进一步强化所有触感品质。焦糖必须感觉更厚、更亮、更有弹性且更有物理重量感。花生必须感觉更像烘烤过的、更自然、略带油感且更有立体感。巧克力外壳必须展现更锐利的断裂边缘、更厚的涂层厚度以及更光滑的高级饰面。牛轧糖必须感觉更致密、更诱人。细小的碎屑、可可粉和微粒必须显得更奢华、精准且悬浮在真实空间中。每个表面都应感觉触手可及且达到收藏级。中心爆发张力：这至关重要。强化中心爆发，使其感觉更紧凑、更剧烈且视觉压缩感更强。巧克力外壳必须伴随力量向外裂开，焦糖必须在分裂的表面之间像拉紧的张力一样伸展，花生必须带着可信的定向能量从核心喷出。海报的中心必须感觉像是破裂瞬间最富戏剧性的千分之一秒，冻结在高级活动图像中。深色负空间：大幅扩大周围的深色区域。外框应陷入丰富、奢华的黑暗中，使视线被迫直接投向中心的爆炸。空白空间必须显得是有意为之、具有电影感且昂贵，使核心产品看起来更像是黑暗舞台上闪亮的珠宝。不要在画面中堆砌额外的道具或大段文字。红金色彩冲击：大幅强化红金色的活动氛围。保持原汁原味的 Baby Ruth 包装辨识度，但让周围的光影、阴影氛围和爆炸场转向更强烈的深红、深樱桃红、古铜金和深可可色调。深红色阴影与金色焦糖高光之间的对比必须比以前更丰富、更炽热、更奢华，同时保持高级感和克制。排版与品牌：仅使用英文排版，配以极短的标题，如“BREAK THE CRAVE”或“GOLDEN IMPACT”。保持文字极简、含蓄，并处于产品的次要地位。包装纸上的 Baby Ruth 标志仍是主要的可读品牌元素。布局必须感觉像是精美的全球糖果广告，而非零售促销海报。背景：使用由深红褐色、黑樱桃色、深可可色和温暖阴影渐变构成的简洁抽象奢华背景。背景必须保持舞台感且整洁，仅在需要时添加柔和的大气深度和细微的色调变化。一切都必须支撑中心的产品及其爆发。光影：使用极其细腻且高影响力的商业照明。用温暖的受控主光塑造包装纸、焦糖光泽、巧克力裂痕、花生表面和悬浮微粒的高级感高光过渡。在爆炸区域周围添加微妙的金调分离光，将碎片从深红背景中勾勒出来。光影必须感觉具有电影感、丰富且昂贵。材质真实感：将真实感推向极致。包装纸必须感觉有触感且物理真实。巧克力外壳必须显示出可信的厚度、平滑的涂层和锐利的断裂边缘。焦糖必须感觉粘稠、沉重、有弹性和光泽。花生必须显示出烘烤的表面纹理、自然的随机性和细微的油光。牛轧糖必须感觉致密而丰富。灰尘和碎屑必须感觉物理上是悬浮的且有重量感。氛围：爆炸般的纵享、红金奢华张力、顶级糖果剧场、珠宝般的中心冲击、电影感的渴望、收藏级零食广告。渲染风格：顶级糖果广告海报，奶云轨道增强，居中垂直 Baby Ruth 巧克力棒，强化的中部爆发展示，扩大的深色负空间，更强的红金对比，飘浮的花生与焦糖喷发，破碎的巧克力外壳，极简活动文字，电影级商业照明，世界级产品真实感，8k。负向提示词：卡通爆炸，虚假焦糖，品牌识别度弱，模糊的包装，杂乱的构图，廉价超市传单风格，明亮繁忙的背景，低细节花生，塑料感的巧克力，文字过多，裁剪的产品，扭曲的徽标，低分辨率纹理，混乱的碎片，中心冲击力弱，负空间不足。
description: An ultra-premium commercial poster prompt designed to create a dramatic, high-tension central explosion effect for a product.

title: Serene Morning Wellness Portrait
content:
9:16 vertical, realistic and bright indoor lifestyle portrait. 
Draw only one fictional adult East Asian woman who is not a real person.
Appearance is {argument name="subject age" default="late 20s"}.
Place the center of the woman's face at approximately 48% of the screen width, and the visual center of the upper body including hair, shoulders, and chest at approximately 50%, not leaning the figure to either the left or right.
Naturally fit from the top of the head to below the chest within the vertical screen, with the face at about 20-43% from the top, shoulders and chest in the center, and the white top continuing to the bottom.
Leave a very thin margin above the head.
Leave a part of the bent right arm and pale beige knee at the right edge of the screen, naturally suggesting the action of the hand touching the back of the head.
Do not unnaturally cut off the forehead, chin, hair, shoulders, or main costume.

The woman is raising one knee on a bright sofa or bed, lifting her upper body slightly.
The face is a two-thirds profile turned toward the left of the screen.
Place her gaze outside the window on the left, not narrowing her eyes too much, and include a very small, calm smile at the corners of her mouth.
A quiet and calm emotion, like vaguely looking outside on a holiday morning.
Do not raise the chin; relax the neck and shoulders.

Facial features are a natural oval shape.
Align the height and size of the left and right eyes, and place a small window catchlight in the dark brown eyes.
Eyebrows are a natural dark brown, not too thin.
Makeup is light, with pale coral lips, natural cheek color, and subtle brown at the outer corners of the eyes.
The skin is bright and healthy, leaving natural pores and slight fine hair on the cheeks and nose.
Avoid excessive skin correction or plastic-like uniformity.

Hair color is dark brown to near black.
Gather it in a {argument name="hair style" default="loose small chignon"} at a slightly high position at the back of the head.
Naturally part the center-leaning bangs to the left and right, leaving a few thin stray hairs at the temples, in front of the ears, and at the nape of the neck.
The right hand lightly touches the hair at the back of the head, with the finger positions naturally hidden in the hair.
Do not create extra fingers or fused hands.

The outfit is a {argument name="outfit" default="plain white ribbed tank top"}.
Thick shoulder straps, a not-too-deep round neckline, soft cotton knit.
Draw fine vertical ribs and natural wrinkles along the body's posture at the chest, armpits, and waist.
Do not include transparency, logos, patterns, or decorations.
The lower body is soft lounge pants in pale beige.
Show the fabric wrinkles of the bent knee at the bottom right of the screen.

The foreground is the woman's shoulder, face, and white top.
The middle ground is a bright ivory sofa or bed.
Place a large white window frame in the background left, with pale daylight outside that is not too blown out.
In the background right, discreetly place a white wall, a thin wooden frame, a blurred houseplant, and small wooden furniture.
Make background objects less prominent than the figure and do not generate text or logos.

The camera is at chest height, slightly lower than the woman's eye level.
Wrap slightly to the left from the front, shooting at a near-medium distance.
Focal length feel is around 50mm.
Avoid wide-angle face stretching or arm exaggeration.
Focus on the face and the forward shoulder, with a shallow to medium depth of field that smoothly blurs to the back of the head, right arm, knees, and background.
Keep the facial contours, pupils, lips, and stray hairs clear.

The main light source is soft natural light entering from the large window on the left.
The light brightly envelops the left cheek, bridge of the nose, lips, neck, and left shoulder, leaving subtle shadows on the right cheek and right arm.
The light is diffused and does not create hard shadows.
Color temperature is slightly neutral to warm.
Exposure is high-key, but retains gradations in the white top and window.
Add a very thin warm color to the woodwork and skin in the background right.
Overall color tone is white, ivory, pale beige, soft brown, and dull green of plants.

Realistically depict skin pores, natural moisture of the lips, transparency of the pupils, fine hair flow, ribbed fibers, and soft cloth texture of lounge pants.
Commercial photo quality reflecting clean, calm morning wellness, loungewear, beauty, and holiday living.
Do not include text, logos, brand names, signatures, or watermarks.
Avoid extra people, extra arms or fingers, missing hands, fused fingers, broken shoulders, twisted necks, asymmetrical pupils, distorted window frames, repeating background objects, excessive chest emphasis, doll-like skin, over-beautified skin, too strong HDR, or illustration style.
description: A cinematic and highly realistic lifestyle portrait prompt of an East Asian woman in her late 20s during a quiet morning, focusing on natural skin textures and soft window lighting.

title: Woman Dancing in a Summer Park
content:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Dancing Hem in the Shade"}

Main Figure:
A full-body vertical shot of a woman in her 20s lightly twirling while holding the hem of a long off-white {argument name="dress material" default="lace"} dress with both hands on the cobblestones of a park surrounded by summer greenery. The woman occupies the center of the screen, with her head at the top center, her thin waist at the center, the spreading skirt at the bottom center, and her bare legs extending to the bottom. She pinches the hem on the left side of the screen with her own right hand and the hem on the right side with her left hand, softly spreading both arms diagonally downward. Her upper body and face are slightly tilted to her own right, her left leg is crossed behind using her right leg as an axis, and her left foot is slightly lifted off the ground. In the middle of the rotation, her {argument name="hair color" default="milk tea brown"} hair and the thin hem flow to the right of the screen.

Person/Expression:
A small oval face, bright ivory skin, thin light brown eyebrows, downcast brown eyes, long delicate eyelashes, pale pink cheeks, and soft coral-beige lips. Her chin is slightly tucked, her gaze is dropped toward the hem of the dress at the bottom left of the screen, and her mouth is slightly relaxed in an expression mixed with concentration and fun. Her hair is bright milk tea brown down to below her chest, with thin bangs and layers around her face, flowing largely from her own left to right due to the wind and rotation. Backlighting from the top right of the screen creates thin golden borders on the crown, outer hair, cheeks, shoulders, and arms. She wears a thin chain and a small single-bead pendant around her neck.

Clothing/Pose:
A fishtail-style dress made of multiple layers of off-white to pale champagne transparent tulle and lace. The deep V-shaped chest is bordered with wide floral lace, and tied in the center front with a thin ribbon. Short flared sleeves falling from the shoulders to the upper arms are made of translucent tulle, with thin lace and frills layered at the ends. From below the chest to the waist, it follows the body with fine shirring and vertical gathers, and the front of the skirt is a short inner layer up to the upper thighs, while the outer side is a long transparent hem flowing from below the knees to the calves. White floral embroidery, vertical weave lines, and multiple waving frills are added to the entire hem, drawing a large arc to the left and right by rotation. Barefoot, the right sole is in contact with the cobblestones, and the toes of the left foot are extended downward and floating.

Background/Light:
The foreground is a park path paved with small grayish-brown stones, showing leaf shadows and thin joints. A bench with a wooden seat and black metal legs is placed in the center-left middle ground, a flower bed with thin grass and small purple and white flowers in the center-right middle ground, and a part of a rough gray stone pillar in the right-end foreground. A thick tree trunk and deep green leaves are on the left of the background, many tree branches and leaves in the center to the top, and a hexagonal pavilion with a gray roof and wooden pillars in the back right. Low black posts and thin ropes continue down the path. Strong natural light shines from the back right of the screen, illuminating the hair, shoulders, sleeves, transparent layers of the skirt, legs, and cobblestones in gold. Round sunlight filtering through the leaves is scattered on the ground and clothing, and the trees in the background have deep green shadows and bright orb bokeh.

Composition/Camera:
A full-body fashion portrait from a camera position slightly lower than the standing person's waist in a vertical screen close to 2:3. The face is placed in the top center, the hands pulled to the left and right in the center, the spreading hem in most of the screen width, and the crossed legs and bare feet in the bottom center. The person occupies about eighty percent of the screen height, leaving margins for bright leaves above the head and margins for cobblestones at the feet. The hem of the dress is close to the left and right edges but keeps the entire arc within the screen, clarifying the lift of the left foot and the grounding of the right foot. Make the face, upper body, hands, and lace clear, and give very light motion to the ends of the moving hem and hair. The bench, pavilion, and trees in the background are softly blurred with a short portrait lens.

Texture/Style:
High-resolution realistic summer fashion photography. Based on off-white, champagne, warm skin tones, vibrant green leaves, and grayish-brown cobblestones. Precisely depict natural skin texture and the soft glow of sunlight, thin clumps of hair, translucency and overlapping of tulle, floral embroidery, lace threads, shirring, waving frills, bare feet, rough cobblestones, and textures of leaves and flowers. Maintain high contrast between the silhouette of the clothing translucent to the backlight and the filtering sunlight, without blowing out the gradations of the white hem, resulting in a bright commercial photo with light movement.

Negative:
Avoid collapse of face or downcast eyes, extra fingers, fusion of hands and hem, deformation of wrists or arms, fusion of crossed legs, reverse bending of knees or ankles, increase or decrease of toes, poor grounding of the right foot, contradiction between the floating left foot and gravity, excessive flipping of the dress, collapse of hem or lace, perspective distortion of the background pavilion and trees, repetition of filtering sunlight, horizontal reversal, text, logo, watermark, and excessive skin processing.
description: Generates a realistic full-body fashion portrait of a woman in a lace dress dancing in a sunlit park, focusing on movement and natural lighting.

title: Dark Yunnan Cuisine Franchise Deck
content:
Goal: Create a complete 10-slide widescreen PowerPoint-style招商手册 / brand investment brochure for a premium Yunnan cuisine brand named {argument name="brand name" default="闲云野鹤"}, with a dark cinematic Chinese landscape aesthetic, suitable as presentation materials for franchise recruitment and brand storytelling.

Canvas: 16:9 horizontal slides, presented as a full brochure deck preview with exactly 10 distinct slides. Use deep black, smoky charcoal, aged bronze, muted gold, tea-brown, and warm lantern highlights. Add generous margins, thin gold divider lines, vertical side captions, subtle page numbers, and refined editorial spacing.

Visual style: Ancient Chinese ink-wash mountains blended with realistic dark food photography, misty forests, cliff silhouettes, old paper texture, burnt edges, faint grain, low-key lighting, premium restaurant atmosphere, Song/Ming dynasty inspired typography, large expressive Chinese brush-calligraphy titles, small elegant serif English subtitles, bronze line icons, seal stamps in muted red, and cinematic depth of field. Overall mood: mysterious, refined, natural, artisanal, high-end, and investment-ready.

Brand and theme: The brochure promotes a growing regional cuisine brand focused on {argument name="cuisine focus" default="Yunnan wild mushroom and mountain cuisine"}. Core message: joining a brand rooted in nature, culture, flavor, and scalable operations. Use the main slogan {argument name="main slogan" default="与山野同行"} on the final slide and the brochure subtitle {argument name="brochure subtitle" default="云南菜馆招商手册"} on the cover.

Slide count and layout: Create exactly 10 slides, each visibly different but unified by the same dark visual system:
1. Cover slide: huge centered brush-calligraphy title “闲云野鹤”, subtitle “云南菜馆招商手册”, small English line “YUNNAN CUISINE INVESTMENT BROCHURE”, year “2026”, mountain valley background, crane emblem above, rustic table at lower right with a ceramic bowl, lidded pot, herbs, and linen cloth.
2. Brand origin slide: title “品牌缘起”, layered mountain background, introductory brand story text blocks, small founder/philosophy notes, decorative vertical side text, and a small red seal.
3. Market opportunity slide: title “风土资产与市场机会”, map-like Yunnan illustration on the left, structured analysis cards and data-style panels on the right, small icons for terrain, ingredients, consumers, and business potential.
4. Product matrix slide: title “招牌产品矩阵”, exactly 5 product cards across the lower half, each card showing one dark gourmet dish photo with a short Chinese label; use warm highlights and gold card frames.
5. Spatial memory slide: title “空间即记忆”, atmospheric restaurant interior photography with wood screens, lanterns, tableware, and private dining mood; include exactly 3 feature blocks along the bottom for entrance, dining room, and private room experience.
6. Store model and profit structure slide: title “店型模型与盈利结构”, exactly 3 main store-format cards across the center, plus a lower row of small metric icons for investment, area, staff, table count, and operating indicators.
7. Headquarters empowerment system slide: title “总部赋能系统”, central circular system diagram with the crane/brand emblem, connected to exactly 6 rounded capability nodes for training, supply chain, marketing, site selection, operations, and product R&D.
8. Reasons to cooperate slide: title “为什么值得合作”, headline emphasizing “不是追逐短暂流量，而是经营可以沉淀的地方风味品牌”, exactly 6 reason icons/cards in a row, ending with a long bronze call-to-action bar near the bottom.
9. Cooperation process slide: title “合作流程”, exactly 6 numbered steps from consultation to opening/operation support, each with a minimal bronze icon, arranged horizontally across the middle.
10. Closing slide: large brush-calligraphy slogan “与山野同行”, subtitle about building a long-term life with regional flavor, crane flying in the upper right, mountain forest background, rustic bowl and pot still life at lower right, exactly 3 centered icon statements below the paragraph: city growth, brand connection, and regional flavor.

Text treatment: Use Chinese as the main visible text, with occasional small English subtitles such as “BRAND STORY”, “MARKET OPPORTUNITY”, “PRODUCT MATRIX”, “SPACE MEMORY”, “STORE MODEL”, “SUPPORT SYSTEM”, “COOPERATION PROCESS”, and “JOIN THE JOURNEY”. Keep text realistic but not overcrowded; prioritize legible headings and visually credible body copy.

Composition constraints: No bright modern colors, no cartoon style, no generic corporate blue, no Western fast-food feeling, no plastic-looking food, no cluttered UI. Maintain consistent branding across all 10 slides, with the same logo emblem, side navigation marks, page numbers, bronze lines, dark atmospheric backgrounds, and premium brochure aesthetics.
description: A premium 10-slide Chinese-style investment brochure deck for a Yunnan cuisine restaurant brand, designed for franchise recruitment and brand presentations.

title: Two-Character Anime Cosplay Portrait

High-resolution, natural proportions, sharp clothing details, anime live-action cosplay vibe, no visible logo, no added text, no watermark.

title: Red New Year Countdown Poster

title: Premium Skincare Campaign Poster Grid
content:
为海蓝之谜（La Mer）创建一个超高端的 2x2 四格护肤营销海报，保持绝对的品牌一致性，但呈现四个完全不同的梦幻自然环境。每个象限必须感觉像是一个独特的奇幻世界，拥有各自的生态特征、色彩氛围和电影感调性，同时这四个部分又必须明确归属于一个统一的 La Mer 视觉宇宙。产品在每个画格中必须是绝对的主角，并完美融入自然，仿佛生来如此。最终作品应呈现出世界级奢侈护肤品系列的高级感，以及像获奖电影画面般凝固的静态美学：超写实的产品摄影、精湛的环境叙事、优雅的自然互动、微妙的梦幻氛围以及收藏级的视觉打磨。采用精致的英文标题排版、含蓄的官方品牌标识，并在高级社论布局中使用极简的辅助文字。

核心布局：
采用严格的 2x2 四格构图，间距均衡，设计规范统一。每个画格必须包含一件 La Mer 核心产品，以视觉主导但环境融合的方式放置。产品绝不能感觉像是强行粘贴进去的，而必须通过光影、水分、反射、材质接触和构图互动，感觉完全沉浸在每个自然世界中。每个画格必须清晰地表达不同的环境身份，同时保持相同的奢华基调、产品比例逻辑和品牌连贯性。

Milk Cloud Orbit + Cream Halo Transit 方向：
进一步强化已确立的最强特质：增强四个不同自然世界之间的对比，精化海洋植物梦幻细节，并将整体视觉语言提升至电影级静物摄影的高度。保留同样的四环境骨架，但让每个画格感觉更像是一个获奖奇幻电影中完美定格的瞬间：更安静、更开阔、更有氛围感、更具情感共鸣。用更强大的电影化环境叙事、更好的深度分层、更自然的光线衰减以及产品周围更受控的视觉留白，取代任何通用的装饰性梦幻感。

系列理念：
四个画格应代表四个完全不同的迷人自然世界，每个都具有强烈的视觉对比和独特的生态特征，但所有画格都必须让人感到奢华、宁静、神奇，且带有鲜明的 La Mer 风格。每个环境必须独立讲述一个自然状态的故事：
1. 潮湿的热带森林避风港；
2. 清凉的海洋悬崖或潮池世界；
3. 薄雾弥漫的月光苔藓森林；
4. 晶莹剔透的海盐矿物植物世界。
这四个世界在色彩、光影、纹理和氛围上必须各具特色，但都应传达出补水、修护、纯净和奢华的护肤语言。

画格 1，热带森林避风港：
将 La Mer 产品放置在温暖湿润的热带雨林林间空地的苔藓石块或天然底座上。周围环绕着优雅的热带叶片、过滤后的阳光、柔和的雾气、露水和郁郁葱葱的深绿色层次感。环境应感觉清新、湿润、阳光明媚，具有极高的自然丰富度。产品应通过柔和的水润光泽、叶片的构图环绕以及金绿色的反射光与环境互动。这个画格应感觉像是充满生机的热带雨林电影剧照中一个宁静的神圣时刻。

画格 2，海洋悬崖或潮池世界：
将 La Mer 产品放置在受潮池、海边悬崖、矿物岩石和海雾启发的清凉海洋环境中。产品可以放置在潮湿的海岩或升起的石块上，周围环绕着温和的海水、海霭、碎海玻璃、矿物水分和冷色调的蓝绿色反射。这个画格应感觉更具水感、通透、海风吹拂且富有电影感，就像清晨在偏远悬崖上捕捉到的画面。

画格 3，月光苔藓森林：
将 La Mer 产品放置在一个更黑暗、更神秘的梦幻苔藓森林中，背景为黄昏或月光下的薄暮。使用深绿黑色的苔藓、湿润的树皮、柔和发光的菌类装饰、微弱的漂浮颗粒、银蓝色的薄雾和宁静的阴影深度。产品应在较暗的环境中发出柔光，营造出一种夜间修护和秘密植物炼金术的感觉。这个画格应感觉像是奇幻故事片中一个隐秘的仪式场景。

画格 4，晶莹剔透的海盐矿物植物世界：
将 La Mer 产品放置在一个精致的梦幻环境中，海洋植物、半透明晶体、海盐矿物构造、湿润的花瓣和淡色发光的自然元素共同营造出一个更加空灵和珍贵的场景。产品应感觉像是从神圣的海洋植物祭坛中生长出来的。这个画格可能是四个画格中最崇高、最神奇的一个，带有微妙的珍珠、翡翠和海泡石色调，但它必须依然感觉优雅且富有电影感，而不是单纯的装饰。

产品写实度：
以极其执着的写实主义和奢侈材质保真度来呈现 La Mer 产品。展示准确的罐体或瓶身比例、精美的玻璃或面霜罐表面、抛光的瓶盖、极高清晰度的标签、洁净的反射和优雅的色调深度。在每个画格中，产品必须感觉纯净、昂贵且带有鲜明的 La Mer 品牌特征。它必须始终是每一格画面的色彩和构图中心。

自然与产品的互动：
在每个画格中，产品和环境必须积极地相互响应。利用石头上的水分、叶片的反射光、玻璃上捕捉到的海雾、触碰底座的苔藓、周围花瓣上的水珠、柔和的薄雾和微妙的自然构图框架。产品必须与周围的自然世界完全协调。这种关系必须感觉是电影般的、有机的，绝不是装饰性或人造的。

水、雾和颗粒的真实感：
以极端的写实感和优雅感呈现水、湿度、水滴、雾气和微粒。每个画格都应包含某种形式的大气水分或自然微粒，但要适应其自身的生态环境：雨林湿度、海浪喷溅、月光森林水汽、矿物薄雾或发光的水润微尘。效果必须感觉干净、高端且符合物理逻辑。保持它们的克制与电影感，仿佛在动作恢复前的静谧空气中暂停。

光影：
在所有四个画格中使用极其细腻、柔和的电影化照明，但要改变光线性质以匹配环境：
1. 温暖的过滤雨林光线；
2. 清凉的海洋日光薄霭；
3. 昏暗的月光森林辉光；
4. 淡雅的神圣矿物照明。
所有照明必须保持奢华、柔和且高度受控。产品必须始终以极高的清晰度被照亮，而环境则支撑其氛围。每个画格应感觉像是精心构思的自然电影照明，而非影棚式的梦幻光效。

电影级的深度与氛围：
让每个画格感觉都像是获奖奇幻自然电影中的静态帧。使用更强的前景-中景-背景分离感、更自然的镜头焦深、受控的薄雾、大气的寂静感以及精心构图的留白区域。避免填满每个角

title: Premium Automotive Lifestyle Poster Layout
content:
Create an ultra-premium 6-panel youth campaign poster for Chevrolet Camaro, fully preserving the exact editorial structure and youthful brand logic of a modern automotive lifestyle layout: a tall vertical poster with two large horizontal hero panels at the top and bottom, and four smaller lifestyle panels arranged in the middle section. The final artwork must feel energetic, stylish, youthful, premium, and globally campaign-ready, while keeping the Chevrolet Camaro as the absolute protagonist. The composition must combine hyper-real car photography, healthy athletic Western youth portraits, clean architectural space, and highly art-directed graphic balance. Use refined English title typography, subtle official-feeling Chevrolet branding, minimal English support text, and a consistent premium layout system across the whole poster.

Core layout:
Use a strict vertical 6-panel composition with:
1. one large hero panel at the top,
2. four smaller panels arranged in a clean 2x2 structure in the middle,
3. one large hero panel at the bottom.
The whole poster must feel unified through one strong visual system: same color palette, same architectural location, same youthful fashion styling, same modern tone, and same brand language. The car must remain visually dominant throughout the entire composition, while the human figures add energy, scale, and youth culture presence.

Critical realism constraints:
Human and car proportions must be fully correct in every panel. The people must have anatomically correct limbs, joints, torso length, head size, hand size, leg proportions, and natural standing or leaning balance. No body deformation, no broken anatomy, no warped perspective on the human figure. The Chevrolet Camaro must keep fully correct real-world proportions, body lines, wheel scale, roofline, hood length, glass shape, and stance. No distorted bodywork, no generic coupe shape, no wrong panel transitions. The people and the car must never intersect incorrectly: no body parts merging into doors, fenders, hood, wheels, windows, mirrors, or seats; no impossible leaning angles; no model clipping; no overlapping geometry errors; no character floating through the vehicle. Every human-car interaction must feel physically believable and spatially correct.

Milk Cloud Orbit + Cream Halo Transit direction:
Push the strongest established qualities further: make the Chevrolet Camaro more dominant in the top and bottom hero panels, and refine the middle four panels so they feel less repetitive and more editorial. Keep the exact 6-panel skeleton, but upgrade the internal rhythm: let two of the middle panels emphasize stylish cropped detail-and-attitude moments, while the other two retain more direct human-and-car interaction. The result should feel more layered, more premium, and more magazine-like, with the Camaro clearly acting as the central force of youth, style, and motion.

Campaign concept:
The campaign should feel like a youth portrait of the Chevrolet Camaro lifestyle: freedom, confidence, energy, urban cool, style, and movement. The young people are not random models; they must feel like a coherent youthful cast linked by the same world. Their interactions with the car should feel natural, aspirational, stylish, and alive. The imagery should celebrate youth and the Camaro together, not treat the car as separate from the social energy around it.

Environment:
Use a clean modern architectural environment with strong graphic surfaces, large open urban space, steps, linear paving, bold walls, and geometric perspective lines. The location should feel contemporary, youthful, and premium, with enough visual structure to support the layout. The environment must stay clean and uncluttered, allowing the car and people to dominate. Strong color-blocked architectural planes are encouraged, especially with energetic but refined saturated tones.

Color system:
Use a youthful but premium color palette with bold saturated backgrounds and architectural surfaces, such as vivid red, magenta, electric coral, clean neutral stone, and metallic blue highlights. The Chevrolet Camaro itself should have a high-impact body color, such as electric blue, bright yellow, satin gray, or another bold performance color that works strongly against the environment. The entire poster must feel vibrant and youthful without becoming cheap or chaotic.

Top hero panel:
Create a large top panel featuring the Chevrolet Camaro in a strong hero view with one stylish young person interacting directly with it. The car should feel more dominant and centered than before, sharply detailed and aspirational. The person may lean against the hood, sit casually near the front, or stand with relaxed confidence beside the car, but all body contact must be physically correct and anatomically believable. Add a bold English title and a short English support line in a refined promotional layout.

Middle four panels:
Create four smaller panels, each showing a different youth-and-Camaro interaction while preserving consistent styling and environment.
- Panel A should focus on expressive youthful portraiture with part of the car visible.
- Panel B should highlight a stylish body detail of the Camaro, such as headlights, side line, hood, or grille, with a figure interacting nearby.
- Panel C should show a more social or playful relationship between young people and the vehicle, such as entering, leaning, walking past, or sharing a moment near the car.
- Panel D should be more fashion-editorial, using a cropped part of the Camaro together with a strong youth pose, emphasizing attitude and design rhythm more than narrative.
All interactions must preserve correct scale and believable spatial separation between human and vehicle.

Bottom hero panel:
Create a large bottom panel that resolves the whole series with a wider lifestyle hero shot. Show the Chevrolet Camaro in a strong three-quarter or side-front view with one or two young people interacting around it in a relaxed, fashionable, confident way. The car must remain the center of gravity, while the youth presence reinforces energy and aspiration. Add another refined English campaign line and minimal branding placement in the same overall layout system. The bottom panel should feel slightly calmer and more conclusive, like the final statement of the series.

People styling:
Use healthy athletic Western young models with natural beauty, fashion-forward styling, and clean contemporary wardrobe choices. The styling should feel urban, elevated, and youthful without being overly luxury-runway. Avoid influencer stereotypes. The people must feel energetic, confident, modern, and naturally photogenic. Their gestures should feel candid yet art-directed.

Vehicle realism:
Render the Chevrolet Camaro with extreme realism and premium automotive fidelity. Show accurate body proportions, paint depth, reflections, wheel detail, glass clarity, front-light signature, muscular surfaces, and strong coupe stance. The Camaro must feel unmistakable, powerful, modern, and aspirational. No generic sports coupe look.

Lighting:
Use extremely delicate soft commercial lighting with cinematic polish. The lighting should be bright, youthful, and clean, with controlled reflections on the car paint and subtle sculpting on the people. The board is not a wheeled skateboard in this campaign. It must be a true surfboard with no wheels, no trucks, and no street-skate hardware, fully integrated into real ocean wave action. Use a healthy Western female athlete with strong posture, real muscle engagement, and sharp technical form. No influencer energy, no soft travel mood. title: Minimalist Nescafé Brand Poster
content: 为雀巢咖啡（Nescafé）创作一张高级垂直品牌海报，“晨间灵感轮廓”版，围绕极简构图构建，其中一个真实的咖啡杯成为连续线条女性侧影的视觉起点。海报必须具有优雅、轻瘈、艺术感且情感细腻，像是一场具有诗意晨间形象的奢侁咖啡品牌宣传。核心视觉创意是，咖啡的温暖和香气通过一条流动的轮廓线勾勒出一个灵感女神。主构图：使用纯净、高饱和度的雀巢然红背景，呈现出完美整洁的摄影棚效果。在画面的下三分之一处放置一个真实的高级咖啡杯，无论是俯视图还是略带角度的视角，都要清晰地展示出里面浓郁的深色咖啡。咖啡杯的渲染必须极其逼真：光滑的陶瓷表面、逼真的咖啡光泽反射、杯缘附近细微的油脂（crema）或微小气泡细节、柔和的自然阴影以及细腻升腾的蒸汽。产品必须让人感到优雅、丰富且无可置疑的高级感。连续线条女神逻辑：从咖啡杯或其蒸汽中，一条连续的白色线条应升起并无缝转化为一个细腻女性面部的侧影。面部应感觉像是一个“晨间女神”：优雅、冷静、充满灵感并被柔和地唤醒。线条应形成额头、鼻子、嘴唇、下巴、脖子，或许还有闭上的眼睛、睫毛或发髻的简化暗示，所有这些都以一种干净流畅的节奏完成。线条必须感觉轻瘈、自信、高级且富有诗意，就像是用咖啡香气制成的时尚插画。它不应看起来像随意的涂鸦或普通的肖像；它必须感到明显优雅且在情感上产生共鸣。女性形象风格：侧影应勾勒出一个现代灵感女神，而非一个详细的人物。保持其细腻、苗条、宁静和令人向往，带有一种安静的晨间羣感和内在灵感。线条可以暗示柔和的发丝运动或微小的女性细节，如睫毛轮廓、脸颀曲线或下颇线，䄦一切必须保持极简。表情应感到平和、深思，并被下方的咖啡微妙地唤醒。相关视觉修饰：如果需要，仅使用极少数极简的辅助元素：一个微小的蒸汽点缀、一两条精细的香气曲线、一个微妙的輱射音符，或一个暗示清晰、灵感或清晨思考的小型象征性手势。这些修饰必须是櫁要的䄦极其制约的，以便咖啡杯和线条肖像保持主导地位。品牌与排版：使用英语作为主要标题语言。在上方区域显著地融入雀巢（Nescafé）标志。添加一个细腻的高级广告标题，例如：“MORNING MUSE”或“DRAWN BY AROMA”或“WAKE INTO INSPIRATION”。添加一个小巧优雅的辅助语，例如：“One cup. One muse.”或“Coffee that sketches the morning.”。排版必须具有艺术感、空间感和高级感，与线条肖像完美平衡。没有凌乱，没有超大的商业文案，没有粗糟的字体。光影：使用抛光的商业产品照明。咖啡杯必须感觉丰富且具有质感，液体中带有细微的镜面高光和真实的深度。白色轮廓肖像应显得清晰干净，轻瘈地漂浮着，具有高级印刷般的锐度。整个图像必须感觉平滑、优雅且具有专业的艺术指导感。情绪：诗意、优雅、女性化、充满灵感、极简、芬芳、品牌导向、高级、细腻、晨间清新。渲染风格：超写实咖啡产品摄影结合优雅的单线连续女性侧影插画，高级极简品牌海报，饱和红色背景，细腻的排版整合，抛光的商业照明，8k，锐利而优美的收尾。负面提示词：凌乱的背景、拥挤的设计、低细节的咖啡杯、随机涂鸦、僵硬的线条艺术、普通的肖像＜工价的海报风格，平淡的光线，扭曲的品牌，沉重的卡通风格，过多的装饰元素，低端咖啡广告。

title: Summer Shaved Ice: Fisheye Perspective
content:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Summer Through Ice"}

Main Body:
Vertical 2:3 realistic photograph. An ultra-wide-angle fisheye composition looking up from inside a large transparent plastic cup. The bottom half of the screen is filled with {argument name="fruit" default="red strawberry pulp"} and crushed ice, with a thick {argument name="straw" default="green straw"} extending straight into the distance from the center. Beyond the circularly distorted opening of the cup, a woman's face is prominently centered.

Character/Expression:
A natural and realistic young woman. Dark brown hair, close to black, tied in a high bun, with thin bangs and stray hairs around the face glowing thinly in the sunlight. Natural makeup with translucency, pale pink cheeks, and glossy lips. Eyes wide open looking straight at the camera, lips slightly rounded while holding the straw. A slightly surprised, cute, and innocent expression.

Clothing/Pose:
A white lace material blouse. Fine ruffles around the neck and shoulders, with a light summer texture. The person leans her face close to the other side of the cup, with shoulders only slightly visible at the bottom. The straw naturally contacts the person's mouth, creating a strong sense of depth from the back towards the red ice in the foreground.

Background/Light:
Background is {argument name="background" default="an old shopping street on a sunny summer day"}. A wooden-style shop front, a shaved ice shop curtain, a strawberry-patterned sign, small white flags, and roadside trees are visible. All text is treated as blurred, unreadable decoration. Strong sunlight enters from the top left, creating fine reflections and highlights on the plastic cup water droplets, cup rim, ice, and red pulp. Shadows fall to the bottom right, with white cream residue forming a ring inside the cup.

Composition/Camera:
The camera is placed extremely low, near the bottom of the cup just above the red ice. A fisheye lens causes the circular rim of the cup to curve significantly, slightly distorting the surrounding shopping street. The bottom 45% of the frame is the foreground blur of red ice and pulp, the center is the straw and the woman's face, and the top is the blue sky and the transparent edge of the cup. Focus is on the woman's eyes and mouth, while the foreground ice is a sparkling shallow blur.

Texture/Style:
Summer advertisement photography style as if taken with a professional camera. High-definition expression of the refraction of transparent plastic, water droplets, the coldness of ice, and the freshness of strawberry pulp. Vibrant contrast between the blue sky, red ice, green straw, and white blouse. Skin retains a natural texture without excessive skin correction. A bright, pop, and slightly humorous Japanese summer dessert photo.

Negative:
Real brand logos, readable text, trademark reproduction, unnatural face, unnatural gaze, collapsed teeth or lips, poor straw contact, extra fingers, missing fingers, fusion of hands and feet, floating ice, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, garbled text, watermarks, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin.
description: A creative fisheye prompt generating a point-of-view shot from inside a shaved ice cup, looking up at a woman sipping through a straw.

title: Hiking Boot Mountain Landscape Poster
content:
Create an ultra-premium cinematic advertising poster for Salomon X Ultra Mid GTX, designed as a monumental giant-perspective mountain fantasy grounded in hyper-real realism. The shoe must be the absolute hero object, transformed into a colossal snow-covered summit rising from a frozen alpine landscape, while real human climbers ascend it as if it were an actual mountain. The scale contrast between the climbers and the shoe must be dramatic and unmistakable: the shoe should feel enormous, architectural, and terrain-like, while the people appear tiny, vulnerable, and determined. The final image should communicate technical mountain performance, waterproof endurance, alpine toughness, and awe-inspiring visual scale.

Main composition:
Use a strong vertical poster composition with the Salomon X Ultra Mid GTX centered and towering upward like a giant mountain peak. The shoe should dominate nearly the entire frame, viewed from a slightly low angle so it feels monumental and heroic. The outsole base should sit embedded in snow and ice like a mountain foundation, while the collar, tongue, laces, and upper structure rise like cliffs, ridges, and frozen ledges. Several tiny climbers should be distributed across the shoe, actively scaling it with ropes, ice axes, and mountaineering posture, creating a clear sense of peril, realism, and adventure.

Core visual concept:
The shoe must feel like a real alpine mountain disguised as a hiking boot:
the toe becomes a snow-covered ridge,
the lace system becomes climbing traverse lines,
the ankle collar rises like a summit wall,
the outsole and midsole become layered ice-rock strata,
snow drifts and frost accumulate naturally on ledges and edges,
small climbers move across the structure like an expedition team.
The illusion must be powerful but believable, with the shoe still clearly recognizable as the Salomon X Ultra Mid GTX.

Product realism:
Render the Salomon X Ultra Mid GTX with extreme fidelity:
accurate shape and proportions,
correct technical upper construction,
authentic lace system,
rugged mid-cut collar,
precise outsole geometry,
realistic mesh, overlays, and support structures,
premium outdoor engineering detail.
Even when scaled into a mountain-like monument, the shoe must remain unmistakably the product and feel mechanically correct.

Human climbing realism:
The climbers must be highly realistic and tiny in scale relative to the shoe:
real alpine climbing posture,
rope tension,
ice axe placement,
snow gear,
mountaineering clothing,
small groups distributed thoughtfully across the shoe.
They must feel like a genuine expedition rather than decorative figures. Their presence exists to emphasize scale, danger, and the boot’s mountain identity.

Environment:
Place the giant shoe in a real frozen alpine environment:
snowfields,
icy wind,
distant mountain silhouettes,
cold atmosphere,
subtle drifting snow,
faint mist or spindrift.
The surrounding environment should support the illusion that the shoe is a mountain within a larger mountain range. Keep it clean and epic, not cluttered.

Snow and surface integration:
The shoe should be naturally integrated with snow and ice:
powder snow clinging to the upper,
ice crust along edges,
wind-packed snow on ledges,
subtle frost accumulation,
small icicle-like formations if appropriate,
snow softly settling into seams and structure.
The snow must feel real and physically responsive to the shoe’s form.

Lighting:
Use extremely delicate soft alpine lighting:
cold high-altitude daylight,
subtle blue-white atmospheric softness,
gentle highlights on snowy edges,
clean material reflections on technical surfaces,
soft shadow transitions,
premium cinematic clarity.
The lighting must feel majestic, cold, and refined, never harsh or artificial.

Background:
Keep the background epic but minimal:
clear alpine sky or soft snow haze,
distant mountain peaks,
broad negative space for brand layout.
Do not overcrowd the scene. The shoe-mountain and climbers must remain the focus.

Typography and branding:
Include a refined official Salomon logo and elegant title such as X ULTRA MID GTX. Add a premium adventure tagline if needed, such as:
“CLIMB THE IMPOSSIBLE”
or
“BUILT FOR EVERY ASCENT”
Typography should feel modern, technical, and art-directed, integrated cleanly into the poster.

Color palette:
cold alpine white,
ice blue,
steel gray,
slate black,
muted technical accents from the shoe,
soft snow-light highlights.
The palette should feel premium, cold, and expedition-ready.

Mood:

title: Nike Vision Sports Campaign Poster

FORMAT:
Vertical 4:5
Sports product SMM poster
8K ultra-detailed

OBJECTIVE:
Position Nike Vision as elite performance eyewear engineered for speed, focus, reaction, and athletic dominance.

Aggressive premium sports realism. Hyper-clean commercial photography. Minimal but extremely powerful. Global campaign quality. Behance front-page quality.

CAMPAIGN DNA:
Speed, Focus, Precision, Reaction, Dominance

Elite Olympic sprinter. Explosive lean muscular build. Low body fat. Visible neck and jaw tension. Performance-driven facial anatomy.

Nike Vision wraparound performance sunglasses. Large aerodynamic shield lens, aggressive angular frame, visible Nike swoosh on temple, lightweight elite athlete engineering

Intense focused expression. Slightly parted lips for controlled breathing. Locked visual concentration. Pre-race mental intensity.

Hyper-real skin texture. Visible pores. Micro facial hair. Natural skin imperfections. Realistic subsurface scattering. Sweat realism: micro sweat beads, temple moisture, forehead perspiration, condensation highlights, neck sheen. No plastic skin.

PRODUCT MICRODETAIL:
Carbon fiber frame texture. Rubber grip temples. Mirror lens coating. Sharp edge reflections. Ultra-clean frame detailing.

LENS REFLECTION NARRATIVE (MOST IMPORTANT):
Lens reflections show sprint track lanes under stadium floodlights. Visible: track lane markings, light streak compression, subtle athlete silhouette reflection, motion energy lines. Reflections must feel cinematic and physically correct.

ENVIRONMENT:
Premium blurred performance stadium. Abstract dark sports environment. Deep atmospheric compression. No clutter.

LIGHTING:
Hero sports lighting. Hard white key light. Strong rim light tracing facial edges. {argument name="accent color" default="Volt"} accent glow. Sharp specular lens highlights. Deep premium contrast.

Primary: Matte Black #111111

TYPOGRAPHY SAFE ZONES:
Large clean headline zone.
Headline: {argument name="headline" default="SEE FASTER."}
Subheadline: ENGINEERED FOR REACTION.

POST PROCESS:
Micro contrast sharpening, Commercial retouching, Subtle bloom, Crisp lens enhancement, Premium billboard finish

Hyper-realistic

title: Cinematic Beast Energy Drink Poster
content:
Positive prompt:
Create a "high-end original brand KV poster" for {argument name="brand" default="Monster Energy"} drink, vertical 4:5. This must be in a completely different form from previous sets. This time, the "beast entity action" is the absolute protagonist, styled as an international sports drink advertisement + cinematic frozen motion photography: strong momentum, strong sculptural feel, strong brand identification, but the frame is clean and restrained with clear negative space, like a real launchable premium brand advertisement.

Core Visual (Beast as protagonist, not just eyes or holding the can):
An original "{argument name="creature protagonist" default="energy leopard/panther monster"}" occupies the main subject, with its full upper body and front claws dominating the scene in a leaping pounce (frozen motion). The beast is not realistic animal style: its skin is composed of a mix of "matte black carbon fiber + obsidian mirror fragments + fine metal mesh," with clear muscle lines and a subtle geometric scale-like texture; neon toxic green energy cracks appear at joints and along the spine, like current flowing under the skin. The beast has strong tension and speed but is not bloody, scary, or showing drooling fangs; overall it looks like contemporary mechanical bio-installation art.

Action and Energy Narrative (New form):
The beast's front claws "rip" three huge green energy scratches in the air. These are not simple logo copies but "light blade fissures" like real space being torn open. Fissure edges have a vitrified green light molten texture with flying particles and jumping arcs; inside the fissures, there is a streamlined texture of cold mist and high-speed airflow, creating strong momentum and spatial layers. Energy scratches span the upper half of the frame, becoming the visual main structure and an advanced recreation of brand symbols.

Product Presentation (Product exists but doesn't steal the lead):
A classic black Monster Energy can is located in the bottom third of the frame, placed on a minimalist basalt/black stone platform, looking like it's "ignited by the beast's power." The can stands upright, covered in dense condensation droplets and light frost, with realistic metallic reflections. The green claw mark logo is clear and sharp with a subtle rim glow, echoing the three energy fissures above. A small amount of ice crystal fragments and water vapor droplets kicked up by the impact surround the can (restrained and clean, do not fill with fog).

Scene and Background (Advanced and clean):
The background is a gradient studio space from deep ink black to dark gray, with very light concrete micro-textures and studio "top light cone" traces. The air contains a small amount of green particles, metal dust, and thin layers of cold mist; overall maintaining high-end clarity and readability, with enough negative space for typography.

Lighting (Brand-level commercial lighting):
Main light is a high-positioned hard spotlight (emphasizing the carbon fiber and obsidian highlights of the beast), fill light is a very weak cold white rim light. Toxic green energy fissures provide internal luminescence, illuminating the beast's claws and the edge of the platform. Strong overall contrast, clear layers, expensive texture, cinematic quality.

Brand Logo and Text (Must appear; art-directed bilingual layout and composition, no crude bold/default fonts):
Text must present a "designer-level typographic system": custom glyphs, fine kerning, grid alignment, optical centering, clear hierarchy. Can be achieved via embossing, metal nameplates, weathered paint, partial UV, or neon edge light for a real brand KV look.
Suggested Typographic Structure (Not obscuring key subject details):
1) Top Brand Identity Area (centered or top-left, small and exquisite):
   Three-claw logo + "MONSTER" + "ENERGY"
   Font: High-end custom torn feel + modern light-weight combination, cold white/gray-white, weak green glow
2) Main Title (located in right negative space, multi-line, strong rhythm):
   "{argument name="main slogan" default="HUNT THE LIMIT"}"
   "UNLEASH ENERGY"
   Font: Cut sans-serif, wide kerning, like a metal nameplate imprint
3) Chinese Main Slogan (bilingual hierarchy, slightly moved down):
   "释放怪兽级爆发"
   "冷能量  即刻上场"
   Font: Modern premium Chinese (light weight + kerning), can be matte embossed or partial UV
4) Bottom Information Area (minimal, restrained, ad footer):
   "ICE-COLD SERVE / STAY SHARP"
   Can add a very small serial number "EDITION 01" (optional, must be restrained)

Color Palette:
Extreme black / Basalt black / Cold gray + toxic green energy light + small amount of cold white highlights; strong branding, sharp, expensive.

Keywords:
premium energy drink campaign, beast hero, cyber panther creature, carbon fiber obsidian skin, neon toxic green energy slashes, cinematic frozen motion, studio spotlight, clean negative space, art-directed bilingual typography, luxury poster layout, hyper-realistic, 8K, vertical 4:5.

Negative prompt:
Repeating forms (centered can + eyes behind + fog), repeating forms (can suspended in beast chest), biting can, beast eye close-up only, bloody/scary, exaggerated drool/fangs, cartoon/illustration style, cheap sci-fi, messy smoke filling the frame, default bold fonts, crude fonts, Comic Sans, Impact, low-level typography, random garbled text, spelling errors, watermarks, UI interface, website, social media accounts, multiple cans, deformed cans, wrong logo, unreadable logo, overexposed neon, low resolution, blurry, noise, dirty, plastic texture.

title: The Archive of Tomorrow Editorial Poster
content: Create an ultra-premium monochromatic editorial art poster titled: THE ARCHIVE OF TOMORROW. The central subject is a thoughtful young creative captured in a three-quarter profile rather than a frontal pose. They wear a structured wool overcoat layered over a minimalist high-neck knit, conveying timeless elegance rather than contemporary fashion trends. Instead of a clean portrait, the subject gradually dissolves into an intricate architectural blueprint made from fragmented geometric forms, technical drafting marks, grid systems, abstract city silhouettes, paper textures, ink washes, and fragmented handwritten notes. It should feel as though their thoughts are becoming architecture. The composition is intentionally asymmetrical. The left side remains spacious with generous negative space, while the right side becomes increasingly dense with layered design elements, archival markings, registration symbols, film perforations, measurement scales, index tabs, editorial dividers, and abstract printing artifacts. No colorful graphics. No neon. No futuristic holograms. Everything should feel tactile, printed, and handcrafted. TYPOGRAPHY AS DESIGN. Typography should function as part of the artwork itself rather than simply labeling it. The dominant headline occupies nearly half the poster: COLLECTING UNWRITTEN FUTURES. The lettering should appear hand-painted with expressive dry-brush strokes layered over distressed paper textures. Surrounding the composition are dozens of smaller editorial fragments such as: EVERY MEMORY LEAVES A BLUEPRINT. IDEAS OUTLIVE THEIR MAKERS. WHAT YOU BUILD FIRST EXISTS ONLY IN SILENCE. PROCESS BEFORE PERFECTION. ARCHIVE NO. 014 OBSERVATION LOG DRAFT REVISION III INDEX OF UNFINISHED THOUGHTS. Tiny catalog details, coordinates, exhibition references, barcode elements, print registration marks, library stamps, archival accession numbers, and minimalist symbols should reward viewers who zoom in. ART DIRECTION: Blend influences from contemporary editorial graphic design, fine-art exhibition catalogues, brutalist layouts, Japanese poster minimalism, Swiss International Style, vintage printmaking, expressive ink illustration, museum branding, luxury independent publishing. The final composition should resemble something displayed in a prestigious contemporary art museum rather than a commercial poster. COLOR PALETTE: Only use warm ivory paper, rich carbon black, charcoal gray, soft graphite, subtle weathered paper tones. No additional colors. The beauty should come entirely from contrast, texture, composition, and typography. VISUAL STYLE: Museum-grade editorial design, Luxury graphic branding, Photorealistic portraiture blended with expressive ink textures, Mixed-media collage without appearing chaotic, Elegant asymmetrical composition.

title: News Reporter Toy Store Scene
content:
Female announcers, etc.
A high-quality image of a female TV announcer introducing a "popular robot toy" in a live TV broadcast style inside a large, bright toy store.
The setting is a large toy store. The store is filled with toy shelves, product packaging, colorful POP displays, aisles, bright lighting, and a lively sales floor atmosphere. The background has a realistic and natural commercial facility look.
IMPORTANT: 
Do not show the robot itself in the frame.
However, the dedicated large display shelves, stands, or dedicated spaces for the robot must be clearly and firmly visible in the frame.
The display space should be large enough to place a robot later and be in a prominent position.
Around the display shelves and stands, place promotional panels, product boxes, related goods, POPs, and description boards that evoke words like "the hottest new robot," "hit product," and "featured exhibit" so that it is immediately clear this is a robot sales/display corner.
However, do not show the overall image or the machine body of the robot itself.
The female announcer is a friendly and neat TV reporter. She is talking to the camera with a bright smile. She is wearing elegant and natural clothing for news reporting. She may be holding a microphone or interview cards. The atmosphere is like a news or information program, introducing the shop while explaining the hot product.
The scene depicts her saying "this robot is so popular it's flying off the shelves." In the background shelves and sales areas, related toy boxes, posters, and promotional panels are lined up to convey that it is a popular product. In particular, the robot display shelves, stands, and empty spaces should be clearly shown, creating a composition where the later presence or departure of a robot feels natural.
Dialogue style:
"Reporting live from the toy department!"
"The hottest thing drawing attention right now is this popular new robot toy!"
"Its popularity is incredible—it's selling like hotcakes!"
"It's attracting huge interest here at the display corner as well!"
"It's the hottest item right now, drawing attention from children to adults alike!"
Composition points:
Place the announcer in the foreground or midground, ensuring the robot display shelves, stands, and dedicated space are clearly visible in the background.
The shelves and stands should have enough presence in the frame so they don't look like there's no room to place anything.
Identify the robot sales/display area clearly through empty display stands, wide shelves, dedicated sections, and surrounding related products.
Three-view (Robot):
A high-quality three-view design sheet for an original popular robot. A clean, setting-material-style layout showing front, side, and back views aligned. White or light gray background. No extra flourishes; the shape of the machine should be clearly visible.
The robot is a sharp, sophisticated near-future mecha design in the style of Virtual-On. It has a slim, high-mobility, linear, and stylish silhouette, aerodynamic armor lines, sharp legs, a flowing body shape, and large vernier units or high-mobility thrusters on the back. Strongly convey the impression of being skilled in high-speed and aerial maneuvers. Overall, a mecha with a sense of speed like those in arcade mecha games.
IMPORTANT:
Create a completely original design that does not look too much like a Gundam.
Avoid the following features:
- V-shaped antennas
- Typical Gundam faces
- Mouth-area face slits
- Tricolor-based color schemes that evoke strong déjà vu
- Classic heroic protagonist symbols used as-is
- Configurations where the combination of a boxy chest and face looks like an existing robot work
Instead, design in the following direction:
- The head is a slender sensor head or a horizontal visor type
- The face is not too human-like, but mechanical and futuristic
- Short antennas, sensor protrusions, or streamlined blade motifs on the head
- Slim, high-density armor configuration for the chest
- Shoulders are sharp and functional, not excessively large
- Arms and legs are slim but powerful, prioritizing mobility
- Large thrusters/verniers on the back stand out as key features of the machine
- The feet are smart shapes prioritizing high mobility over grounded stability
The color scheme should be a stylish, futuristic original coloring, combining colors like white-gray, blue-gray, black, silver, purple, turquoise, and orange. The design should look persuasive as a serious mecha popular enough to be commercialized, rather than just a toy.
Carefully render panel lines, joints, overlapping armor, sensors, thrusters, and details. However, prioritize a light and agile impression over heavy armor.
The main goal is for the front, side, and back designs to be clearly understood. Overall, complete it as a three-view drawing of a high-mobility original near-future mecha capable of taking flight into the sky.
Do not include unnecessary numbers, long explanations, storyboard elements, or handwritten notes on the screen. If necessary, keep it to a small, natural live-TV-style ticker. Overall, create a single image in a bright, natural news report style where the announcer and the robot display space are easy to recognize.
description: A prompt for generating a scene where a female news anchor reports on a popular robot toy from within a bright, busy toy shop.

4. Batter folding: a spatula gently folds fluffy meringue into pale yellow pancake batter in a glass bowl.

7. Covered steaming: the thick pancake cooks under a glass lid in the pan, condensation and steam visible, pancake rising high.

Constraints: Use exactly 12 panels, exactly 3 rows and 4 columns, chronological cooking sequence from ingredients to eating, no text inside the image, no people’s faces, only hands and tools where needed. Keep the overall theme centered on {argument name="main ingredient" default="extra-thick soufflé pancakes"}, with {argument name="lighting mood" default="warm golden morning kitchen light"}, {argument name="art style" default="high-detail cinematic anime food illustration"}, and {argument name="aspect ratio" default="21:9 wide storyboard sheet"}.

The main toy driver is a {argument name="character description" default="yellow LEGO-style male minifigure with brown hair, yellow shirt, blue pants, and claw hands"}. The setting is a {argument name="setting" default="miniature brick-built city street at sunset"}. Storyboard panels: Include exactly 12 discrete panels with these shots and captions:
01. Wide establishing shot. The car is parked outside a modern toy-brick house.

Constraints: Exactly 12 panels, exactly 3 columns and 4 rows, no extra panels, no missing captions, no watermark. Maintain continuity of the same blue car, same toy figure, same miniature city, and same sunset lighting across all frames. Make the image feel like stills from a polished miniature car commercial titled {argument name="commercial mood" default="playful luxury toy-car adventure"}.

• An internal cross-section that reveals layering, structure, or internal design

• A small schematic or sectional diagram showing mechanical / design logic

title: Minimalist Studio Editorial Grid

Strictly preserve the real identity characteristics of the person in the photo, including face shape, facial feature proportions, eyebrow and eye structure, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, perceived age, hairline, hairstyle features, and overall temperament. Do not turn the person into someone else; avoid excessive beautification, influencer-style aesthetics, or AI-generated fake faces. Image Format:

Each cell features the same person in the same studio setting but with different views, including facial close-ups, half-body shots, profile shots, shoulder and neck details, waist details, back views, upper body movement, and two-thirds body compositions.

Character Setting:
An adult East Asian female with a natural, clean, soft, and fashionable temperament, reflecting the aesthetic sense of women from first-tier cities. The overall feeling should be elegant, relaxed, and feminine, but must be high-end, restrained, and natural—not vulgar, not overly sexy, not studio-style kitsch, and without influencer filters.

Hairstyle and Makeup:
Retain the real hairstyle base from the original photo, but it can be slightly styled to be more voluminous, airy, and naturally lustrous. Hair can be naturally loose, slightly messy, with a light wind-blown effect. Makeup should be clean and elegant, skin with a natural glow, preserving real skin texture; no heavy makeup, no exaggerated eye makeup, no plastic skin.

Outfit:
The person wears a white slim-fit cropped tank top, a white knit vest, a white off-the-shoulder top, or a white ribbed sleeveless top, paired with light blue loose jeans. Accessories include minimalist thin necklaces, thin bracelets, or small earrings. The overall outfit is clean, light, and fashionable, like the minimalist female photo style popular in major cities in Korea/Japan/China. Clothing should fit the body naturally but not be overly revealing or sexualized.

Scene:
A clean indoor studio with a background of warm beige, cream, or light camel walls. No clutter, no furniture, no text, no logos. The overall environment is minimalist, warm, and soft, like a high-end fashion magazine shoot set.

Lighting:
Soft warm studio lighting, with light coming softly from the front-side or above, giving the skin a slight creamy texture and natural highlights. Shadows should be soft; no hard flash, no strong contrast. The overall atmosphere is warm, dreamy, and cinematic.

3x3 Grid Content:

Grid 1:
Facial close-up, head slightly turned, hair naturally falling along the side of the face with a slight wind-blown feel. Eyes looking at the camera or slightly away, expression quiet, confident, and soft.

Grid 2:
Profile half-body shot, the person standing, body sideways to the camera, one hand naturally raised to tidy the hair, eyes closed or head slightly lowered, pose elegant and relaxed. Highlight the profile, neck, and upper body lines.

Grid 3:
Shoulder, neck, and collarbone detail, showing only the chin, neck, shoulder line, white top, and thin necklace, without showing the full face. High-end, restrained, with a magazine detail close-up feel.

Grid 4:
Soft emotional facial close-up, eyes closed or half-closed, hair naturally sweeping across the face, relaxed expression, slight soft focus and warm light.

Grid 5:
Half-body fashion shot, one hand naturally placed near the collarbone or lightly resting on the upper chest, the other hand hanging naturally. Movement should be elegant; no exaggerated gestures, expression quiet and atmospheric.

Grid 6:
Two-thirds body or near full-body shot, person in a white cropped top and light blue jeans, hands naturally raised or stretching, posing like a natural stretch in a studio. The image should be fashionable, clean, and light.

Grid 7:
Shoulder, neck, and hand detail, capturing the white top, thin necklace, and fingers lightly touching the collar or shoulder. Hands must be natural and structurally correct, no deformation, not overly sexy.

Grid 8:
Back view or side-back shot, person facing away from the camera, one hand naturally raised to tidy hair, revealing the upper back silhouette and long hair lines. Elegant and restrained, not over-exposed.

Grid 9:
Waist and upper body detail, capturing the white cropped top, light blue jeans, waistline, and fabric details. Composed like a fashion magazine detail outfit shot, no full face needed.

Overall Photography Style:
High-end fashion magazine editorial, warm minimalist studio shoot, slight film feel, soft focus but clear features, natural skin tone, clean visuals, lifestyle moodboard atmosphere. Lens feel like 35mm to 85mm portrait photography, shallow to medium depth of field, sharp subject, simple soft background.

Expression and Pose Requirements:
The nine images should not all have the same expression or angle. There should be variety: looking at the camera, closing eyes, profile, head down, tidying hair, body stretching, back view, and detail shots. Overall natural, relaxed, and elegant; not like an ID photo, not like a Taobao model stiffly posing.

Consistency Requirements:
All nine images must maintain consistency in the same person's face and temperament. Composition, pose, angle, and cropping can change, but do not change face shape, facial feature proportions, nose, lips, eyes, skin tone, or perceived age. Do not make people in different cells look like different individuals.

Hand and Body Stability Requirements:
Hand movements must be simple and natural. Do not generate extra fingers, deformed fingers, broken wrists, misplaced arms, or strange body structures. If hands are prone to error, automatically simplify the movement. Priority is given to the realism and naturalness of the person, followed by pose complexity.

Restrictions:
No other people, no cluttered backgrounds, no text, no watermarks, no logos. No exaggerated heavy makeup, no excessive skin smoothing, no plastic skin, no cartoon style, no vulgarity or pornography, no excessive exposure, no incorrect human anatomy, no blurred low-quality faces.

Final Output:
A single 4:5 vertical 3x3 fashion photography grid collage. The overall effect should be close to a high-end female editorial moodboard in a warm minimalist studio: clean, soft, fashionable, natural, restrained, and atmospheric.

title: Inflatable Surreal Product Poster
content:
Design a '4:5' product poster for an '{argument name="fruit" default="orange"}' juice 3d bottle using playful inflatable-plastic packaging surrealism where the bottle behaves like a squeezed toy object mid-pressure. The poster should communicate juiciness, tension, and tactile freshness through a bottle that visibly bulges, stretches, and compresses like a soft object being squeezed from the inside out.

SUBJECT: 
A single bottle dominates the center-left, illustrated in a semi-3D stylized form (not photoreal). The bottle is visibly distorted—its midsection bulges outward while the neck is slightly compressed, as if internal juice pressure is pushing against the container walls. The liquid inside exaggerates this effect, forming rounded convex surfaces pressing against the plastic. The cap is slightly tilted from pressure. The bottle feels elastic, alive, and reactive rather than rigid.

COMPOSITION: 
The composition mechanic is “internal pressure distortion”. The eye enters through the most inflated part of the bottle (center bulge), then follows curved tension lines outward toward stretched typography on the right side. The camera uses a slightly low, close-up perspective with mild fisheye distortion, amplifying the sense of pressure and expansion. The bottle leans diagonally into the frame as if pushing against invisible resistance. Negative space on the right is intentionally stretched and warped, echoing the bottle’s deformation.

TYPOGRAPHY: 
Headline: “{argument name="headline" default="SQUEEZE BACK"}” in thick, rounded, inflated lettering that mimics air-filled plastic. The type is physically distorted—letters stretch horizontally near the bottle and compress toward the edges, as if affected by the same pressure force. The headline sits to the right of the bottle but partially overlaps its bulging edge. Subheadline: “Juice that pushes back.” in a narrow condensed sans, straight and rigid, contrasting the soft headline. Small circular microcopy labels (e.g., “100% organic”, “no added sugar”) appear like printed stickers slightly warped by the surface tension.

LIGHTING / GRAPHIC TREATMENT: 
Soft studio lighting adapted for stylized rendering—broad diffused highlights across curved surfaces, subtle specular streaks that follow the deformation. No realistic reflections—only controlled, simplified highlight bands that emphasize volume and elasticity.

COLORS: 
'orange' juice bottle color and 3d header text. Small accents of 'bright lime green' for sticker elements. High contrast between glowing orange and dark surroundings.

BACKGROUND: 
A smooth dark gradient field with subtle radial tension lines expanding outward from the bottle, like invisible pressure waves. No texture clutter—clean but dynamically warped space.

STYLE: 
Neo-pop surreal product illustration with inflatable material logic, playful distortion, and high-impact commercial clarity.

FINISH:
Soft plastic-like rendering, clean edges, controlled gradient transitions, no noise or grain, polis
description: A playful, neo-pop surrealist product poster for juice using inflatable plastic textures and internal pressure distortion effects.

title: Chinese Sour Fish Restaurant Poster

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, warm off-white rice-paper background with subtle fibers, faint ink-wash mountains along the bottom edge, premium Chinese dining advertisement style.

Main visual: In the center, show one large steaming ceramic bowl of golden sour pickled-cabbage fish soup. The bowl has blue-gray Chinese landscape patterning. The soup is glossy yellow-gold with visible chopped pickled greens, tender white fish slices, red dried chilies, green Sichuan peppercorns, yellow ginger strips, sesame-like spices, and rising steam. Central label: Above the bowl, place an ornate rounded rectangular label with gold text 「金汤酸菜鱼」 and a thin decorative border.

Left ingredient column: Title 「精选食材」. Show exactly 4 ingredient items stacked vertically, each with a small circular food photo and text: 1) 「鲜鱼片」 with subtext 「活鱼现切，嫩而不散」, 2) 「老坛酸菜」 with subtext 「发酵90天，酸脆回味」, 3) 「猪骨高汤」 with subtext 「8小时慢熬」, 4) 「红灯笼椒+青花椒」 with subtext 「一辣一麻」. Connect the 4 items with a thin dotted vertical orange line.

Right selling-point column: Title 「产品亮点」. Show exactly 4 rounded white cards stacked vertically, each with one simple orange/green icon and text: 1) fish icon, 「当鱼现杀」 and 「每片都带皮」, 2) droplet icon, 「减盐25%」 and 「喝汤不口干」, 3) jar icon, 「川式老坛」 and 「自然发酵无添加」, 4) rice bowl icon, 「下饭神器」 and 「一鱼三碗饭」.

Beneath, add a glossy orange rounded button with white text {argument name="call to action" default="酸爽下单"} and a small right-arrow circle.

Footer: Add small text 「更多优惠活动 | 搜索 渔堂白」. Under it, place exactly 4 small circular platform icons/labels: Douyin-style music note, 「小红书」, 「美团」, and a simple person/share icon.

Visual style: High-end Chinese food poster, realistic steaming dish photography blended with brush-calligraphy typography, warm cream/gold/orange/brown palette, clean symmetrical layout, strong depth and shine on the soup, no clutter, no extra dishes or extra text beyond the specified elements.

title: Bitter Melon Lemon Soda Poster
content:

Top brand area: At the very top center place a small cute green lion mascot logo, then the brand name “凉兽”, and the slogan “苦都苦得很快乐”. Add a thin decorative divider underneath.

The glass should look cold, wet, and refreshing with condensation and reflections. Add loose droplets on the tabletop.

Include subtle blurred green leaves at the bottom left foreground for depth.

Footer: Along the very bottom add small app/platform icons and text: “抖音 / 小红书 / 美团 / 大众点评  搜索：凉兽”.
