title: Modern Sukeban Street Portrait
content: A full-body fashion-editorial street portrait of a modern-day Japanese delinquent schoolgirl vigilante standing wide-legged in the middle of a busy Tokyo entertainment district intersection, photographed from a slightly low angle for a bold heroic presence. She is a young Japanese woman with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair tied in a high ponytail with loose strands, wearing a white sailor-style school blouse with a navy collar and a large deep red bow, a short dark navy pleated skirt, an oversized black leather biker jacket, white crew socks, and chunky white sneakers with bright red laces. In one hand she loosely holds a metallic yo-yo hanging by its string as a signature weapon, while her other hand rests in her jacket pocket. The pose is confident, rebellious, and confrontational, like a contemporary reinterpretation of {argument name="character concept" default="Sukeban Deka"}. Set the scene on a real urban Tokyo street with zebra crossing lines under her feet, cars stopped behind her, pedestrians along the sidewalks, and tall buildings packed with vertical Japanese shop signs and billboards fading into the background. Use shallow depth of field so the city remains recognizable but softly blurred, while the subject is crisp and centered. Lighting is bright natural daytime with soft contrast, realistic skin tones, premium fashion photography sharpness, and a cinematic urban cool-girl mood. Emphasize realism, high detail in the leather texture and pleated skirt, subtle wind in the ponytail, and a polished contemporary Japanese street-style aesthetic.

content: Please create a commercial advertising poster for an ultra-thin tactile simulator device. A clean, minimalist background. A quiet, emotional atmosphere like the cover of a high-end lifestyle magazine. [Text Placement] Japanese Catchphrase: "{argument name="catchphrase" default="Your fingertips become the gentlest place in the world."} " Elegantly placed at the top or center-left in a thin modern Mincho font. The brand name "Anima" and product name "Lene" are placed modestly but with a sense of luxury in a clean sans-serif font at the bottom right. Without using real brands or people, express a world where cutting-edge technology is put into practical use as 'kindness'.

title: Luxury Black and Gold Sneaker Ad
content: Create a dramatic premium sports shoe advertisement in a dark studio with cinematic black-and-gold lighting. A single athletic male model is captured in an explosive action pose from an extreme low-angle wide-lens perspective, with one oversized sneaker thrust toward the camera so it dominates the foreground. He is mid-leap or lunging forward, one knee bent, one arm stretched outward, wearing a metallic bronze bomber jacket over a black fitted shirt, black athletic shorts, black crew socks with a small gold triangular logo, and sleek black-and-gold running sneakers. The shoe design should feel futuristic and luxury-focused, with black mesh panels, glossy black leather overlays, metallic gold accents, gold eyelets, branded tongue detail, and a sculptural open heel support element. Add glowing gold energy streaks, sparks, debris, and an impact burst radiating from the ground beneath the lead shoe, with a glossy reflective floor catching the highlights. In the background, place huge illuminated golden typography reading {argument name="brand text" default="VOLTEX"} and smaller text reading {argument name="product line" default="ELITE"}, integrated behind the athlete as part of the composition. Use high contrast, sharp detail, commercial fashion photography styling, dynamic motion blur only in the particles and light trails, luxurious premium athletic branding, and a bold hero-shot composition suitable for a footwear campaign. Include 2 visible shoes, 2 visible socks, 1 jacket, 1 shirt, and 1 pair of shorts. Add a small top-right corner watermark area with the text {argument name="watermark brand" default="insMind"} and {argument name="watermark model" default="GPT Image 2"}. Keep the palette predominantly black, bronze, and glowing gold.
description: This prompt generates a dramatic premium athletic footwear advertisement with a male model in motion, ideal for sneaker campaigns, sports branding, and high-impact social ads.

title: Neon AI Video Workflow Dance Poster
content: A high-energy cyberpop promotional poster for an AI video workflow, featuring 5 young female dance performers in a confident K-pop-inspired formation on a futuristic neon stage. The center performer stands slightly forward with hands on hips, wearing a white asymmetrical crop top and a dark blue sequined mini skirt, long light brown wavy hair, athletic slim build. Flanking her are 2 performers in matching black leather crop tops and black leather shorts, also hands on hips, long dark hair, bold stage styling. On the far left is 1 performer in a pink corset-style sleeveless top and white pleated mini skirt. On the far right is 1 performer in a fitted white cropped jacket and white mini skirt. All 5 women wear glamorous concert styling, bare legs, and statement necklaces, with strong stage confidence and symmetrical spacing. Behind them, enormous Chinese headline text dominates the upper half: {argument name="headline text" default="影片工作流"}, rendered in oversized metallic white 3D block letters with hot pink and purple neon glow, glossy highlights, and beveled edges. Beneath the headline are 6 workflow labels in glowing capsule boxes, split into two groups: left side 3 labels "策划", "拍摄", "剪辑"; right side 3 labels "调色", "特效", "输出". The background is a dark concert-like sci-fi environment with radiant purple laser beams, starburst lens flares, magenta light streaks, and a reflective glossy floor mirroring the figures and lighting. Use a wide cinematic composition, centered poster layout, ultra-saturated magenta-violet palette, polished commercial key art, dramatic rim lighting, high contrast, glossy skin highlights, and a sleek AI-generated entertainment marketing aesthetic. Make it look like a bold social media cover image for a one-stop AI music video production pipeline.

title: Minimal Sunscreen Product Cover
content: A clean, minimalist product still life for a beauty reel cover, shot in a vertical 9:16 composition. title: Premium Japanese Gym Poster
content: A premium vertical poster advertisement for a fictional sports gym brand, photographed in a realistic high-end fitness editorial style. Show a fit athletic adult woman with a toned, curvy physique in a modern gym, captured from upper thighs to head in a dynamic three-quarter pose while performing a cable machine exercise. She has {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair tied in a high ponytail with loose strands, lightly glistening skin as if from sweat, and she wears a deep navy blue high-cut one-piece training bodysuit with thin straps. Her right hand grips a black cable handle close to her waist, with the cable extending diagonally down to the right; her left arm is bent and braced outward near the machine column. Use dramatic warm sunlight from the side mixed with cool gym ambient light, strong highlights on shoulders, chest, arms, and thighs, shallow depth of field, blurred weight machines in the background, and a luxurious, motivational commercial fitness atmosphere. Compose the layout like a Japanese gym poster with bold white Mincho-style vertical headline text in the upper left reading {argument name="headline text" default="整える強さ。"}, a thin blue horizontal line beneath it, and a smaller white subheadline below reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="無理をしない。続ける。"}. In the bottom left, place a minimalist geometric logo mark above the brand name {argument name="brand name" default="NOVAFIT"} in white uppercase sans serif, with the small tagline {argument name="tagline" default="STRENGTH & BALANCE"}. Clean premium typography, strong contrast, aspirational branding, practical ad-poster design, 4:5 vertical format.

title: Surreal Crocs Summer Ad Poster
content: Create a surreal lifestyle fashion advertisement poster for {argument name="brand name" default="crocs"}. Vertical composition, photorealistic, golden-hour outdoor lighting. A young woman sits relaxed on a grassy lakeside meadow filled with small white daisies, leaning against an enormous oversized foam clog in a pale sage green color. The giant shoe should dominate the scene like a playful sculpture, positioned behind her at a slight angle with the heel strap raised upright and visible round logo rivet on the side. Show realistic Crocs-style details: ventilation holes on top, textured molded foam surface, thick sole, front ports, and side perforations. The model wears matching light green clogs, white scrunched crew socks, a muted sage green cropped tank top, high-waisted cream patterned shorts, an open loose white shirt draped off her shoulders, and a simple necklace. She has dark hair in a messy bun and reclines with one knee bent, gazing upward in a carefree pose. Background: calm lake, distant green hills or low mountains, and a bright blue sky with large soft cumulus clouds. Use a clean editorial ad aesthetic with cheerful, airy summer vibes, shallow depth of field but enough clarity to keep both the model and giant clog sharp. Add centered white brand text at the top: large rounded lowercase logo reading {argument name="logo text" default="crocs"} with a small trademark symbol, and beneath it a white slogan line reading {argument name="tagline" default="Come as you are. Comfort follows."}. Emphasize harmony between the model's outfit and the shoe color palette, aspirational comfort, whimsical scale contrast, and polished commercial photography.
description: This prompt generates a polished vertical lifestyle ad featuring a woman relaxing beside a giant Crocs-style clog, ideal for playful fashion campaigns and mock brand posters.

title: Cubist Chinese Membership Promo Poster
content: Create a bold Chinese promotional poster in a chaotic Mondrian-meets-Fauvism-meets-Cubism graphic style, with thick black outlines, irregular geometric color blocks, and a high-contrast palette of red, blue, yellow, white, and black. The layout is a dense single-page vertical membership campaign poster with multiple tilted panels and sharp angular divisions, like cut-paper collage and retro commercial poster design. At the top center, place a huge white trapezoid panel with oversized black Chinese headline text: "大会员" on the first line and "首次招募" on the second line, with the year {argument name="year" default="2026"} in large bright blue numerals integrated into the headline. Along the left side, include 4 decorative icon/mascot elements: 1 circular bear-face logo in a yellow circle at the upper left, 1 blue-and-white clock icon below it, 1 half-body black-and-white bear mascot in the mid-left wearing a blue scarf and raising one arm, and 1 cropped bear mascot face at the bottom left. In the left-center, add a tall red countdown panel with white Chinese text "倒计时仅剩" at the top, an enormous yellow numeral "1" in the middle, and a large white "天" at the bottom. On the upper right, place a large white pricing panel showing the original price line "原价 ¥2999/年" with a strikethrough over 2999, then the discounted line "到手价" above a giant red price "¥1299/年". Beneath that, create a blue header strip labeled "省钱攻略" and divide the area into 3 vertical offer columns labeled 1, 2, and 3. Column 1 shows "领券立减" and a large blue "200" with a percent-style coupon icon below. Column 2 shows "拼团再减" and a large red "1500" with three simplified person icons in blue, yellow, and red below. Column 3 shows "成团即得" and a large red "¥730" with smaller black text "专属赠礼" and a gift box icon below. In the lower left, add a white benefits panel with a blue tab title "核心权益". Inside, place 2 small rectangular portrait thumbnails at the upper left, then to the right list 3 text rows: "AI × 家庭教育 × 元学习", a blue-highlighted name "howie" followed by black Chinese descriptive text, and a red-highlighted name "savage" followed by black Chinese descriptive text. Under these, include 4 bullet-like benefit rows with small blue icons: "全年直播陪伴，会员无限期回看", "会员专享逐字稿 + 三级笔记", "All in One AI 知识库 24*7 答疑", and "免费送一个家庭账号，和队友一起学". Across the lower middle, create a black horizontal strip with white text: "AI 内参 1 年（¥365） + 实物大礼包（¥365）". Below that strip, show 3 product images side by side: 1 magazine-style booklet cover, 1 orange notebook/book cover, and 1 blue book cover, plus 2 small round mascot badges near the products. At the bottom center, place a large blue call-to-action panel with big white Chinese text "扫码立刻拼团" and yellow subtitle text "— 锁定首发价 —", then a smaller line in white and yellow: "平均每天 3.55，撬动全家 AI 学习力！". At the bottom right, add a large black-and-white QR code in a white square. Along the very bottom, create 2 footer bars: on the left a blue strip with a shield icon and white text "价保承诺：180 天降价立即退差价", and on the right a red strip with a card/payment icon and white text "轻松支付：花呗 12 期分期免息". Use very heavy sans-serif Chinese typography, exaggerated scale contrast, dynamic asymmetrical composition, overlapping panels, and an energetic commercial poster feel for social media marketing.
description: This prompt generates a colorful geometric Chinese marketing poster for a membership launch, useful for social media promotions, campaign ads, and sales announcement graphics.

title: Skincare Commercial Storyboard
content:
Create a clean, bright {argument name="product type" default="skincare commercial"} storyboard in a 16:9 layout with 9 panels. Use soft natural lighting, minimal aesthetic, and a fresh, airy mood with white and pastel tones. The {argument name="subject" default="main character is a young woman with soft makeup and styled hair"}, wearing light, elegant clothing. The setting is a modern, sunlit interior with large windows and a calm atmosphere. No text or subtitles anywhere.
Show a clear story flow: she starts at her desk looking slightly tired or concerned, then a close-up of her face showing dry or dull skin. She discovers a clear skincare bottle and gently presents it. Show a close-up of the liquid pouring onto her hand, followed by her applying it to her face. After use, her skin looks hydrated, glowing, and smooth. Transition to her feeling confident and refreshed, walking in a bright, clean space with soft breeze and flowing elements. End with a calm product beauty shot on a minimal surface, then a final frame of her smiling softly at the camera while holding the product.
Focus on natural expressions, glowing skin, and a transformation from dull to fresh. Include cinematic close-ups, soft focus, light reflections, and subtle sparkles to enhance the clean beauty feel. Keep everything elegant, minimal, and visually soothing with no branding text.
description: Generates a 9-panel storyboard for a skincare commercial, focusing on product use, transformation, and airy visual flow.

title: Clay Toy Landing Page UI
content: Create a warm, playful Japanese landing page for a children's clay toy brand, designed entirely in a handmade soft clay diorama style. In the hero section, place a large dark-brown clay headline on the left reading "こねて、つくって、あそぼう。" and a smaller supporting sentence beneath it reading "手ざわりが楽しい、やさしい粘土のおもちゃセット。" Add 2 rounded clay call-to-action buttons below: "商品を見る" and "ギフトにする" with a small gift icon. On the right side of the hero area, arrange 12 clay toy illustrations: a rainbow with clouds, a lion, an elephant, a block tower with red roof, a green circular badge reading "対象年齢 3+", a beige oval badge reading "安全素材", a white rabbit holding a carrot, a tree, a yellow ball, a blue toy car, a pink donut, and a strawberry, plus a small red star near the lower right. Below, create a 3-card benefits row, each card made from off-white clay with icon, title, and short Japanese description. Card 1 title: "やわらか素材" with a hand holding clay icon. Card 2 title: "くり返し遊べる" with a circular arrow icon. Card 3 title: "想像力を育てる" with a lightbulb icon. Under that, add a centered section title "人気のセットラインナップ" with 4 small colored dots around it. Then show 3 product cards. Card 1 has a blue badge "人気No.1", shows 4 animal figures: lion, elephant, rabbit, giraffe, and includes the title "どうぶつセット" and price "¥2,980" with a teal button "詳しく見る". Card 2 has an orange badge "おすすめ", shows 7 snack items: donut, cake slice, strawberry shortcake, pink ice cream cone, cookie, candy pieces, and small leaves, and includes the title "おやつセット" and price "¥2,680" with an orange button "詳しく見る". Card 3 has a blue badge "NEW", shows 4 vehicle toys: red car, airplane, police car, excavator, and includes the title "のりものセット" and price "¥3,200" with a navy button "詳しく見る". Add a horizontal reassurance strip with 3 items: a heart icon with text about parent-child fun, a gift icon with text about gift popularity, and a shield icon with text about safety and安心・安全. At the bottom, create a large coral clay banner with the headline "お気に入りのセットを見つけよう" and a cream button reading "今すぐチェック". Finally add a slim footer bar with 4 compact items and icons: "5,000円以上で送料無料", "最短当日発送", "30日間返品保証", and "サポート対応". Use a balanced, grid-based web layout, front-facing view, soft natural lighting, subtle shadows, highly polished product-design mockup quality, charming handcrafted claymation aesthetic, and a premium yet child-friendly feel.

title: Japanese Summer Accessory Ad Poster
content:

Show a young woman from the waist up standing on a tropical beach with turquoise ocean, pale sand, soft sky, and slightly blurred palm leaves in the upper right background. She wears a wide-brim natural straw sun hat with a blue ribbon band, long straight dark hair, and a loose blue-and-white tie-dye top. Her face is obscured by a centered soft rectangular blur block. title: Luxury Dream Home Real Estate Flyer
content: Create a polished vertical real-estate promotional flyer in a clean, modern social-media ad style, 4:5 poster composition. Use a bright daytime outdoor theme with a pale blue sky, soft clouds, and leafy green tree branches framing the top left and top right corners. The layout should feel like a premium property investment advertisement with bold typography, glossy marketing design, and a teal, red, white, and gray color palette. At the upper left, place a small uppercase headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="LIVE BETTER. INVEST SMARTER."}. Directly below it, add a very large stacked main headline: {argument name="main headline line 1" default="OWN YOUR"} in deep teal and {argument name="main headline line 2" default="DREAM HOME"} in vivid red, using a bold condensed sans-serif font. Beneath that, add a teal ribbon banner with white uppercase text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="LUXURY LIVING. LASTING VALUE."}. Under the tagline, show exactly 3 circular feature icons arranged horizontally with thin vertical separators between them: a shield icon with the caption "SECURE YOUR FUTURE", a rising bar-chart icon with the caption "HIGH VALUE INVESTMENT", and a house icon with the caption "MODERN & ELEGANT". In the middle left and lower center, feature a large photorealistic contemporary luxury house with 2 stories, white and gray exterior walls, black trim, large glass windows, a balcony, landscaped shrubs, and a paved driveway, shown from a front three-quarter angle. On the right side, place a waist-up adult Black man in a green knit sweater, facing forward and pointing directly at the viewer with an assertive sales-poster pose; his body overlaps the house and extends into the foreground. Near his lower torso, add a glossy red circular badge with a slight 3D effect containing large white uppercase text {argument name="callout text" default="BUY NOW!"}, and attach a small dark teal angled banner across its bottom edge reading "LIMITED UNITS AVAILABLE!". Across the bottom, create a dark teal panel containing exactly 3 rounded rectangular property cards with white borders and equal spacing. Card 1 should show a row of modern townhouses and the label "MODERN TERRACES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Spacious Rooms" and "24/7 Security". Card 2 should show a luxury villa with a pool and the label "LUXURY VILLAS"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Premium Amenities" and "Prime Locations". Card 3 should show a detached upscale modern home and the label "EXCLUSIVE HOMES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Registered Title" and "Trusted Developer". At the very bottom, include one large empty white rounded rectangle spanning most of the width as a placeholder area for contact details or footer information. Make the overall image crisp, high-contrast, commercial, aspirational, and professionally designed like a premium real-estate marketing poster.
description: A bold vertical real-estate ad poster promoting luxury homes and property investment, ideal for social media marketing or sales flyers.

title: Origami Dinosaur Pop-Up Book Ad
content: A polished children's pop-up book advertisement on a dark studio background, featuring an open hardcover book with thick white pages and a teal-green cover lying on a tabletop. From the center fold, a highly detailed white paper origami T-rex bursts upward in a dynamic roaring pose, mouth wide open with sharp triangular teeth, tiny clawed arms raised, thick folded legs planted in layered paper jungle foliage, and a segmented tail extending backward. The dinosaur should look handcrafted from crisp folded cardstock, with visible geometric paper panels and clean origami seams. Behind it, the right-hand page stands partially upright and catches a dramatic shadow projection of the T-rex profile, creating a large silhouette with open jaws; also include small paper-cut scenery on that page: 3 flying pterosaurs and a simple mountain landscape. Surround the dinosaur base with dense cut-paper plants and grass emerging from both pages. Light the scene with a cinematic warm spotlight from the upper left, leaving the background in deep navy to black, with soft realistic shadows cast across the book and onto the raised page. At the top center, include bold white ad typography in stacked lines reading {argument name="headline text" default="DINOSAURS POP UP ADVENTURE"}, with a white ribbon banner below that reads {argument name="tagline" default="A WORLD OF WONDER IN EVERY PAGE"}. At the bottom center, place 4 evenly spaced circular feature icons with captions in white: an open book icon labeled "AMAZING POP UP DESIGNS", a hand icon labeled "HANDCRAFTED WITH CARE", a shield icon labeled "DURABLE & KID FRIENDLY", and a light bulb icon labeled "INSPIRES IMAGINATION". Premium toy catalog style, cinematic product photography mixed with paper craft illustration, centered composition, high contrast, ultra-clean, whimsical, family-friendly, realistic paper texture.

title: Realistic Woman at Japanese Bus Stop
content: A realistic candid street photo of a young East Asian woman sitting at a glass-walled bus stop on a bright sunny day in Japan, framed as a vertical portrait from mid-thigh up. She has dark brown hair tied back in a low ponytail with soft side bangs and wears small dangling earrings, a fitted white camisole or tank top under a white blazer, and a high-waisted dark navy or black pencil skirt. Her posture is relaxed, seated slightly angled toward the camera with one shoulder closer, giving a polished office-worker look. Behind her on the left is a bus route timetable board filled with Japanese text and route numbers, including visible numbers like 226, 609, 670, 632, and 合D32. On the right side in the background, a blue city bus with a yellow roof is approaching or stopped along the curb, softly out of focus. The bus shelter has reflective glass panels, metal framing, and a bench, with a sunlit sidewalk, tree shadows, and urban buildings in the distance. Use natural midday lighting with crisp highlights and soft shadows, shallow depth of field, realistic skin and fabric textures, clean commercial photography style, high detail, DSLR-like bokeh. Replace the obscured face area with a natural, fully visible face of an attractive adult woman, keeping the expression calm and neutral. Use {argument name="outfit color" default="white blazer with white top and dark skirt"}, {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"}, {argument name="location" default="Japanese urban bus stop"}, and {argument name="bus color" default="blue with a yellow roof"}.

title: Anime Summer Soda Ad Poster
content: A bright, high-energy anime-style summer advertisement poster for a sparkling soft drink, set at the seaside under a vivid cobalt-blue sky with towering white cumulus clouds and a blazing sun near the top center creating lens flare and radiant beams. Feature exactly 3 Japanese high school girls in matching summer sailor uniforms: short-sleeved white blouses with navy ribbon bows and dark navy pleated skirts. All three have dark, windblown shoulder-length to long hair and youthful, lively poses. In the left foreground, show one girl from a dramatic low angle thrusting a large plastic soda bottle toward the viewer so it dominates the composition; her hand and the bottle are oversized by perspective. In the middle, show a second girl seated low near the water, one knee raised, drinking from a smaller bottle. On the right, show a third girl standing in profile or three-quarter view, also sipping from a bottle while her hair and skirt stream in the sea breeze. Make the ocean water intensely turquoise and sunlit, with energetic splashes framing the bottom left and bottom right edges, scattered droplets and sparkling highlights across the scene. Add a few small white seabirds in the distant sky. The overall mood is refreshing, nostalgic, youthful, and cinematic, like a premium Japanese beverage commercial key visual. The bottle label should be clean and minimalist white with modern sans-serif typography reading {argument name="brand name" default="ASCII SPARK"}, with smaller flavor text {argument name="flavor text" default="Yuzu White Peach Soda"} and a subtle 500 mL marking. Place the brand logo in the upper left in thin uppercase letters, and add a handwritten-style Japanese tagline in white at the lower left reading {argument name="tagline text" default="夏がくれる、はじけるひととき。"}. Use crisp cel-shaded anime rendering mixed with painterly light effects, ultra-detailed water droplets on the bottle, condensation, transparent plastic, glittering carbonation bubbles, and dramatic foreshortening.
description: This prompt generates a polished anime-style Japanese beverage advertisement poster featuring 3 schoolgirls, a sparkling soda bottle, and a vivid seaside summer atmosphere for commercial key art or mock branding.

title: Concept to Form Design Process
content:
Subject: [e.g., {argument name="subject" default="Tennis Serve"}] 
Please present the transformation process of this theme from concept to form, as well as the completed design as the final result, in an A4 vertical visual image. Two-part structure (top and bottom). 
The top section is a five-step visualization flowchart of the essence of the theme: Source of Inspiration → Trajectory & Energy → Abstracted Lines & Structure → Three-dimensional Form → Final Design. Build it according to this flow. Fine sketches, line drawings, design blueprints, small arrows, short English labels, and a layout with elegant negative space. 
The title is "MOTION TO FORM." 
The bottom image displays the final 'hero visual' image formed from the process above. The category is not fixed; the AI chooses the most suitable design object based on the theme. It can be any form, such as a product, object, furniture, accessory, packaging, vessel, lamp, gadget, accessory, artwork, etc. 
Generate a fictional brand name, slogan, and short copy to create creative content suitable for advertising or design release visual effects. 
The overall presentation has a high level of completion, merging concept boards, brand advertisements, and design development materials. A sense of beauty composed of minimalism, poetry, intelligence, and negative space. The color palette is based on neutral tones, paired with 1-2 accent colors derived from the theme. 
Accurately depict material feel, light, shadow, structural beauty, and texture representation. High resolution, commercial-grade visual quality.
description: A sophisticated prompt that generates an A4 vertical visual mapping the transformation from a concept to a finished product design.

title: Japanese Summer Sports Drink Poster
content:
A photorealistic Japanese summer beverage advertisement poster in a tall vertical layout, designed like an official sports drink campaign. Show a full-body teenage schoolgirl standing outdoors on a sunny hilltop road overlooking a coastal town and the ocean under a vivid blue sky with large white clouds. She is centered slightly left, posed confidently with one leg relaxed, looking off into the distance, holding a clear plastic bottle of {argument name="drink brand" default="POCARI SWEAT"} in her right hand near shoulder height. She wears a classic Japanese sailor school uniform: 1 white short-sleeve sailor blouse, 1 navy sailor collar with white stripes, 1 large navy neckerchief bow, 1 navy pleated skirt to the knees, 2 white knee-high socks, and 2 dark navy or black loafers. Her hair is long, straight, and black with a glossy sheen. Bright midday lighting, crisp shadows, fresh clean atmosphere, high realism, commercial poster finish.

Use a strong brand-forward composition. In the top left, place a large bold white logo reading "ION SUPPLY DRINK" above oversized {argument name="main logo text" default="POCARI SWEAT"} with a white wave shape beneath it. In the top right, add a small white corporate mark and the text {argument name="company name" default="Otsuka"}. On the right side, set a vertical Japanese headline in dark blue reading {argument name="headline text" default="渇いたからだに、水よりうれしい。"}. In the lower left, add a Japanese body copy block in blue, including a larger subheading and several smaller lines of explanatory text, styled like authentic ad copy. Near that text, include 1 white circular information badge with blue Japanese text and 2 small inner circles labeled "水分" and "イオン" joined by a plus sign. At the very bottom left, add small blue recycling-related fine print and iconography; at the bottom right, add the website URL {argument name="website" default="www.pocarisweat.jp"}. Make the overall design feel like a believable premium Japanese poster for a refreshing ion supply drink, suitable as a desktop wallpaper.
description: A realistic Japanese-style beverage advertising poster featuring a schoolgirl in a sailor uniform against a bright coastal sky, ideal for wallpaper or mock campaign visuals.

title: Japanese Fashion Cover with Koinobori Dresses
content: A fashion magazine cover styled like a luxurious Japanese women's magazine, photographed in soft natural daylight against a pale blue sky with a faint city skyline blurred in the background. The masthead is huge and elegant across the top, reading {argument name="magazine title" default="Lumiére"} in oversized soft pink serif lettering, with small Japanese cover text above and around it, plus a small issue marker on the upper right reading "5", "May 2026", and "No.218". Center the cover on exactly 2 young adult Japanese women standing close together from about thigh-up, facing camera in a poised editorial pose, with their faces intentionally obscured by smooth soft rectangular blur blocks. The woman on the left wears a flowing pale blue dress inspired by koinobori carp streamers: high Mandarin-style collar, sleeveless inner dress, long sheer cape panels draping from the shoulders, elaborate layered metallic and satin fish-scale appliqué across the bodice, a large stylized fish eye motif on the chest, more scale detailing and fin-shaped ornamentation at the hip, and a cinched waist with decorative jeweled clasp. Her dark hair is in an elegant updo with loose wisps, and she wears dangling earrings. The woman on the right wears the same design concept in pale pink and white, also with a high collar, translucent cape-like side panels, layered fish-scale bodice, a visible fish eye motif near the waist sash, soft pleated skirt, tassel ornament at the belt, and matching dangling earrings; her dark hair is also swept into a refined updo with a few loose strands. The overall styling is airy, graceful, feminine, and sophisticated, mixing traditional Japanese elegance with modern couture. Use a pastel palette dominated by baby blue, blush pink, white, and subtle gold trim, with bright but diffused lighting and a premium glossy magazine editorial finish. Include visible Japanese cover lines arranged like a real magazine layout: one left-side block introducing the cover girls, one large main headline block across the lower half, one right-side vertical cluster of smaller teaser text, and exactly 2 pale blue circular callout badges on the right side containing Japanese text; the upper badge advertises a special appendix gift set and includes exactly 2 small product images of pouch-like accessories, and the lower badge contains a shopping-plan checklist with exactly 3 checkbox lines. Add a small pink ribbon-like label above the main headline. The composition should feel clean, aspirational, and seasonally themed around Golden Week and koinobori fashion.
description: This prompt generates a polished Japanese magazine cover featuring two women in pastel carp-streamer-inspired couture, ideal for editorial fashion, seasonal campaigns, or mock magazine designs.

title: Okinawa Summer Travel Banner
content:
Create a polished Japanese travel agency summer banner ad for Okinawa in a bright, inviting commercial style. Use a wide horizontal layout with a vivid tropical beach scene as the full background: crystal-clear turquoise ocean, white sand shoreline, small green island in the mid distance, deep blue sky with large fluffy white clouds, and palm leaves hanging in from the upper right corner. On the right foreground, place 1 traditional Okinawan shisa lion-dog statue sitting on a stone wall, surrounded by red hibiscus flowers and lush tropical greenery. Near the water, include 1 small glass-bottom sightseeing boat floating close to shore. Add 2 small simple fish doodle icons over the sea.

Make the typography the hero element. Across the left-center to center, place very large Japanese calligraphic headline text reading {argument name="headline text" default="夏の沖縄"}, with a blue gradient and white glow or soft outline, highly legible and elegant. Above it, add a handwritten-style Japanese catchphrase in blue reading {argument name="catchphrase" default="青い海、青い空、心ほどける島時間。"} with a loose underline flourish. Under the main headline, add a smaller Japanese subheading reading {argument name="subheading" default="感動の景色と、あたたかいおもてなしに出会う旅へ。"}.

In the upper left, add a circular summer badge with a sunburst feel, soft cream background, tiny wave lines, a small hibiscus accent, and Japanese text reading "この夏は 沖縄で 最高の思い出を!". Decorate the headline area with 1 pink hibiscus flower on the left and subtle ocean-wave graphic strokes.

Along the lower middle, place 3 rounded white feature cards in a row, partially overlapping the beach scene. Count and depict all 3 cards clearly: the first card shows a sea turtle swimming underwater in a circular photo, with Japanese heading "美しい自然を満喫" and smaller body text about transparent waters and scenic spots; the second card shows a bowl of Okinawa soba in a circular photo, with heading "沖縄グルメを堪能" and smaller body text mentioning 沖縄そば and ゴーヤチャンプルー; the third card shows Shuri Castle in a circular photo, with heading "観光スポットも充実" and smaller body text mentioning 美ら海水族館 and 首里城. Add small coral, shell, hibiscus, and starfish decorations around these cards.

On the right lower-middle, overlap the beach with 1 tilted circular promotional sticker in pale blue and cream, with a small yellow tab on top. The yellow tab says "早めの予約がおトク!" and the main circle says "夏の沖縄ツアー 好評受付中!". Add a white plumeria flower accent near the sticker.

Create a full-width dark blue footer bar across the bottom. On the left side of the footer, place a white travel company logo icon and company name text {argument name="company name" default="〇〇旅行株式会社"}, with a smaller Japanese tagline below. Across the center of the footer, place exactly 3 circular line-icons with short Japanese captions: 1 calendar icon for tour plans, 1 support staff icon for travel assistance, and 1 suitcase icon for comfortable travel help. On the right side of the footer, add a boxed CTA area with Japanese text "詳しくはこちらから" and a mock search field containing {argument name="search text" default="〇〇旅行　沖縄"} plus a search icon. Overall design should feel premium, cheerful, summery, and highly marketable, like a professional Japanese web banner or travel campaign visual.
description: A bright Japanese travel-agency promotional banner for Okinawa, suitable for summer tour ads, website hero images, and campaign marketing.

title: Anime Fashion Magazine Cover
content: A stylized Japanese fashion magazine cover titled MODE TOKYO, designed like a glossy contemporary women's style publication. The composition is a high-angle, dynamic street-fashion anime illustration of 2 girls looking up toward the viewer from beside a brick wall with colorful graffiti and dramatic sunlight. The girl on the right has {argument name="hair color" default="golden blonde"} hair in a lively messy ponytail with loose bangs, bright green eyes, a wide cheerful grin, and a sporty-feminine outfit: a light blue lace-trim camisole or slip-style top, short bottoms, chunky white sneakers, and a black choker. She is posed energetically, leaning forward with one knee bent, giving a confident summer-fashion editorial feel. The girl on the left has long vivid teal-green hair with straight heavy bangs, large blue eyes, and a calm, cool expression. She wears a casual layered street outfit in dark tones with a sleeveless top and sits lower in the frame, angled toward the right girl while gazing upward. Use bold cel-shaded anime rendering with crisp linework, glossy highlights in the hair and eyes, soft skin shading, and a polished commercial illustration finish. The background should combine sunlit urban texture, blurred mural colors in pink, purple, orange, and black, and deep shadows to create contrast. The overall palette mixes hot pink typography, summer sunlight, teal, blonde, and saturated street-art hues. Include dense magazine-cover typography in a premium editorial layout: a giant pink serif masthead reading {argument name="magazine title" default="MODE"} across the top with TOKYO vertically on the left; on the upper right a dark circular or rounded block containing {argument name="issue number" default="06"}, JUNE 2024, vol.218, and cover lines in Japanese; on the left side several smaller Japanese and English fashion blurbs including NEO BASIC STYLE and SPORTY × FEMININE; a pink circular badge on the right with Japanese text and Trend 7; a large hot-pink Japanese headline across the lower left and center reading 私らしく、もっと輝く季節。; elegant white handwritten script diagonally across the lower right reading Shine in my Style; small footer cover lines and hashtags in Japanese; and a small BEAUTY label at bottom right. Make it look exactly like a real high-end Japanese fashion magazine cover, vertical format, full bleed, vibrant, youthful, feminine, sporty, and trendy.
description: This prompt generates a polished anime-style Japanese fashion magazine cover with two stylish girls, dense editorial typography, and a vibrant sporty-feminine streetwear aesthetic.

title: Chinese Tomato Nutrition Poster
content:
A clean premium food advertisement poster on a light gray-white studio background, featuring {argument name="fruit name" default="tomatoes"} as the hero subject. In the center, show exactly 7 tomato pieces arranged on a shallow round wooden plate: 5 whole ripe red tomatoes stacked in a natural pyramid, 1 halved tomato standing upright at the front center with glossy flesh and visible seeds, and 1 wedge slice placed at the lower right foreground. The tomatoes are fresh, vivid red, covered with realistic water droplets, with green stems attached to most whole fruits. Add a few green leaves and two small yellow tomato blossoms near the lower right edge for freshness accents. Use soft commercial lighting, gentle shadows, sharp focus, and highly realistic texture, in a polished supermarket-poster style.

Design the layout as a Chinese nutrition and freshness infographic poster. In the upper left, place a large two-line Chinese headline with strong typographic hierarchy: the first line in black reads {argument name="headline line 1" default="自然成熟"}, the second line in large warm red reads {argument name="headline line 2" default="营养美味"}. Below it, add a smaller gray Chinese slogan: {argument name="slogan text" default="每一口都是大自然的馈赠"}. Under the slogan, place exactly 3 simple red line icons in a horizontal row with short Chinese labels and gray sublabels beneath each: 1) a sun icon with text "充足日照" and subtext "自然成熟", 2) a sprout or leaf icon with text "科学种植" and subtext "健康美味", 3) a heart outline icon with text "新鲜采摘" and subtext "产地直供".

On the right side, create a thin curved red guide line framing the tomatoes, with exactly 4 circular nutrient callouts stacked vertically from top to bottom. Each callout is a red or red-orange gradient circle with a white symbol or letter inside, connected to the curve. Use these Chinese labels and explanatory text: 1) top callout with "C" and title "富含维生素C", description "有助于增强免疫力 促进胶原蛋白合成"; 2) second callout with a molecular icon and title "番茄红素", description "强效抗氧化剂 有助于抵御自由基"; 3) third callout with a leaf icon and title "膳食纤维", description "促进肠道蠕动 帮助消化"; 4) bottom callout with "K" and title "钾元素", description "有助于维持 心脏健康".

On the left lower side of the tomatoes, add exactly 2 red text feature callouts with fine red leader lines: the upper one titled "美味多汁" with smaller gray text "果肉饱满，汁水丰富 酸甜可口，回味无穷"; the lower one titled "新鲜采摘" with smaller gray text "人工精选，严格挑选 确保每一颗都新鲜优质".

Across the bottom, place a rounded rectangular nutrition table bar in white with light gray dividers. On the left end, add a solid red rounded label block containing the Chinese title {argument name="table title" default="营养成分表（每100g含量）"}. To its right, show exactly 6 nutrient columns with gray headings and darker values beneath: "能量" "20kcal"; "蛋白质" "0.9g"; "脂肪" "0.2g"; "碳水化合物" "4.2g"; "维生素C" "14mg"; "钾" "179mg". Center a tiny gray footnote below the table: "* 数据来源于《中国食物成分表》". Overall style: elegant Chinese fresh-produce marketing poster, balanced whitespace, red-accented infographic design, realistic product photography blended with clean vector UI elements.
description: A polished Chinese produce advertisement showing fresh tomatoes with nutritional callouts and a bottom nutrition table, ideal for grocery, packaging, or food marketing visuals.

title: Professional Brand Packaging System
content:
Please create a high-aesthetic, high-completion "Brand Packaging System Display Image" for the brand {argument name="brand name" default="Brand Name"} in the category {argument name="category" default="Product Category"}. This is not a common e-commerce white background shot, nor a single product photo, but a brand proposal-style display showing a 'packaging family' with visual identity system logic and commercial photography texture. The image should reflect the 'unified implementation of a single brand across multiple packaging carriers,' presenting a complete packaging system for a mature consumer brand.

[Aspect Ratio Requirements] The overall composition must be a fixed 4:5 vertical poster. Horizontal compositions or scattered arrangements are prohibited. The layout should follow poster reading logic: breathing space at the top, the main visual focus of the packaging system in the center, and auxiliary packaging, labels, and products at the bottom. The weight should be concentrated and suitable for immediate release as a brand display poster.

[Core Requirements] Automatically match the most reasonable packaging combination based on the [Category] and build a unified visual system around the [Brand Name]. Choose a small but representative number of packaging forms to form a refined system. Prioritize hierarchy, brand unity, and display beauty over quantity. You can include: shopping bags, gift boxes, shipping boxes, long boxes, single item boxes, pouches, sleeves, sample bags, bottles, jars, tubes, spray bottles, pump bottles, labels, stickers, tags, cards, and the actual product itself.

[Category Adaptation] Adapt packaging forms to the [Category]: e.g., paper bags and food containers for Bakery; cups and sleeves for Coffee/Tea; jars and tubes for Beauty/Skincare; candles and cards for Fragrance/Lifestyle; drawer boxes and tags for Fashion/Collectibles. The result must feel category-appropriate and systematic.

[Quantity Control] Control the number of items; do not overcrowd. The scene should be "less is more." Suggest: 1-2 large items, 2-3 medium items, 2-4 small items/labels, and 1-3 actual products. Total visible elements should be between 6-10. Ensure enough white space and clear hierarchy.

[Visual System] All packaging must belong to the same brand system, using the [Brand Name] as the core element. Maintain consistent logo placement, font style, graphics, illustration/pattern systems, and material texture. The style can be minimalist, organic, modern, luxury, or youthful, but must be mature and high-quality.

[Color Mechanism] Avoid fixed combinations. Generate different schemes like Cream White/Caramel Brown, Mist Blue/Warm White, Olive Green/Linen Beige, Chocolate Brown/Ivory, etc. Avoid neon or cheap high-saturation colors. Maintain a sense of high-end restraint.

[Composition] Use a commercial studio setting with a 3/4 top-down or slight perspective view. Arrange in layers: large items in the background, core packaging in the mid-ground, and small items/products in the foreground. At least one product should interact with its packaging (e.g., half-out of a box). Create a balanced triangular or staggered composition.

[Visual Style] High-end commercial photography feel. Clean studio background (white, warm white, light grey). Emphasize material textures (paper folds, box structures, bottle silhouettes, print quality, embossing, matte/cotton/kraft textures). Modern and clean visual language.

[Lighting] Commercial grade lighting. Soft studio light or slight directional natural side light. Use clear but restrained shadows for depth. The light should be transparent and bright, never dark or messy.

[Final Effect] The final image should look like a mature brand's packaging proposal poster or visual landing page, emphasizing vertical poster feel, brand unity, systematic completeness, and commercial photography quality.
description: A comprehensive, high-aesthetic prompt for creating a complete brand packaging system display with commercial photography quality.

title: Commercial Ad Storyboard Layout
content:
Create a cinematic commercial storyboard sheet.

LAYOUT:
- Fixed 6-panel grid (2x3), evenly spaced
- Clean white or neutral background
- Each panel clearly separated, no UI, no clutter

GLOBAL STYLE:
- Cinematic realism, high-end commercial look
- Soft controlled lighting, consistent across all panels
- No character or environment drift

STORY ARC (strict order):
1. Setup
2. Tension
3. Product reveal
4. Product interaction
5. Transformation (impact)
6. Clean closing shot

SCENE CONCEPT:
{argument name="story concept" default="A woman lives in a quiet apartment with a tense, unpredictable tiger. The tiger behaves like a domestic cat but carries constant danger. When she serves the product (cat food), the tiger visibly relaxes and transforms into a calm domestic house cat."}

PANEL REQUIREMENTS (for EACH panel include):
- Cinematic frame (clear composition, subject readable)
- Shot / Action (focused on character + product when applicable)
- Camera (shot type, angle, movement)

PRODUCT RULES:
- Product must be sharp, readable, and well-lit in panels 3, 4, 6
- No distortion, no redesign
- Packaging must remain consistent

VISUAL PRIORITIES:
- Strong contrast between tension (tiger) and relief (cat)
- Clear readability in every frame
- No abstract or surreal distortion, grounded realism

TEXT:
- Minimal, small, professional labels only (panel number + short shot note)
- No extra graphics
description: A highly structured prompt for generating a six-panel commercial storyboard layout with consistent characters and a narrative progression.

title: Japanese Legal Services LP Banner
content: A Japanese listing-ad style landing page hero banner for a fictional law office and tax accountant office, designed like a bold web advertisement with four equal vertical panels across the top and a strong call-to-action area across the bottom. The top row contains exactly 4 service panels, each with a colored header bar, a photo-realistic stock-photo image, and a colored caption bar at the bottom. Panel 1 is red and labeled 「刑事事件」 at the top, showing a close-up of two hands gripping dark prison bars against a black background; the bottom red caption reads 「逮捕・訴訟に即対応！」 in large bold white Japanese text. Panel 2 is blue and labeled 「交通事故」 at the top, showing a realistic rear-end car crash with two damaged dark-colored sedans on a city street in daylight; the bottom blue caption reads 「慰謝料・示談もお任せ！」 in large bold white Japanese text. Panel 3 is green and labeled 「相続税」 at the top, showing an elderly couple seated at a table consulting with a suited professional, with papers and a small house model visible; the bottom green caption reads 「税相続対策をしっかりサポート！」 in large bold white Japanese text. Panel 4 is orange and labeled 「離婚問題」 at the top, showing a distressed woman sitting indoors with her head resting on one hand; the bottom orange caption reads 「慰謝料・親権の悩みを解決！」 in large bold white Japanese text. Make the four panels touch edge-to-edge with clean white dividers, each panel occupying the same width, and use highly saturated primary colors with glossy ad-design styling. Beneath the four panels, create a cream or light beige background footer area. On the left side, place a smaller black subheadline in Japanese: 「法律相談・税務相談なら」. Centered below it, place the large main office name in metallic gold gradient bold Japanese lettering with a slight bevel effect: 「{argument name="office name" default="〇〇法律事務所・税理士事務所"}」. Add thin black horizontal divider lines above and below the main office name. On the lower right, place a large glossy red rounded rectangular button with a bright gradient and white bold Japanese text reading 「{argument name="button text" default="無料相談受付中！"}」. The overall style should feel like a Japanese legal and tax services LP main visual from a listing ad: corporate, urgent, trustworthy, commercial, photo-based, clean grid layout, bold typography, high contrast, and realistic brochure-quality compositing.

title: Japanese Inheritance Tax LP Hero
content: Create a clean, premium Japanese landing page hero image for a fictional tax accountant office specializing in inheritance tax consultation. The design should look like a modern listing-ad LP first view, wide desktop format, with a soft ivory and warm white background, muted sage green and gold accent colors, elegant serif Japanese typography for the headline, and a calm trustworthy atmosphere. On the left upper area, place a refined circular logo with a thin gold ring, a large serif letter C, and a small botanical line illustration, followed by the office name 税理士事務所 {argument name="office name" default="C"} and the English subtitle TAX ACCOUNTANT OFFICE {argument name="office name" default="C"}. In the top right, add a rounded white contact bar split into 2 blocks: a phone block with a green circular phone icon, the small text 初回相談無料・土日祝も対応, and the large number {argument name="phone number" default="0120-987-654"}; and a mail block with a gold circular mail icon and the text メールでのお問い合わせ 24時間受付中. The main headline on the left should be large Japanese text reading 相続の不安に、安心という答えを。, with the key phrase 安心という答えを。 in sage green. Beneath it, add a supporting sentence in smaller Japanese text: 相続税の申告・節税対策を、経験豊富な税理士がご家族の想いに寄り添い、丁寧にサポートします。 Below that, place 3 rounded rectangular feature cards in a row with pale backgrounds and green line icons: card 1 shows a document icon and the text 相続税申告実績 1,000件以上 with a tiny note ※累計実績; card 2 shows a bar chart icon and the text 節税対策のご提案で 税負担を軽減 with a tiny note ※状況により効果は異なります; card 3 shows a group icon and the text 初回相談 無料 with a tiny note 安心の明朗会計. On the right half, show a bright consultation scene photo-style image: 3 Japanese adults around a desk in a sunlit office with greenery in the background, consisting of 1 male advisor in a navy suit seen from behind on the right, and 2 clients facing him, a middle-aged man in a light beige jacket and a woman in a white blouse. Place an open laptop on the table. Their expressions should feel calm and attentive. Overlay a pale circular badge near the lower right of the photo with delicate leaf decoration and the text 安心の 相続専門サポート わかりやすいご説明ではじめての方も安心. Across the lower middle, add a slim consultation invitation line reading 相続に関するお悩み、まずはお気軽にご相談ください, framed by diagonal slash marks. Under it, place 4 rounded category tabs in a row: 相続税の申告, 生前対策・節税, 遺産分割サポート, 二次相続対策. At the bottom right, add a large green rounded contact CTA area split into 2 main columns: the left column with a white phone icon, the small text お電話でのお問い合わせ（フリーダイヤル）, the large number {argument name="phone number" default="0120-987-654"}, and the small line 受付時間 9:00〜18:00（土日祝対応可）; the right column with a white mail icon, the text メールでのお問い合わせ 24時間受付中, and a rounded white button reading ご相談はこちらから. Along the very bottom, create a white reassurance strip with 3 horizontally arranged items separated by thin vertical dividers: 1) shield icon and 秘密厳守・プライバシー保護を徹底, 2) clipboard icon and 明朗会計・事前お見積りで安心, 3) handshake icon and 相続の専門家がワンストップで対応. Use subtle shadows, rounded corners, soft natural light, polished commercial web design, and a highly believable Japanese legal-tax service advertisement aesthetic.
description: A polished Japanese landing page hero for a fictional inheritance tax accountant office, suitable for legal and tax service advertising mockups.

Below it, add a short supporting paragraph in Japanese about supporting clients with divorce-related worries and helping find the best solution, with one phrase highlighted in pink. On the right side, show a bright, airy photo of a Japanese woman in her 30s with short dark brown hair, wearing a loose white top, seated indoors on a sofa by a window, resting her face lightly on one hand and looking thoughtful; her face is obscured by a large rectangular blur block for privacy. Along the very bottom, place 3 slim footer-style trust points separated horizontally: one about focusing on divorce consultation for women, one about consultations from family and friends also welcome, and one about nationwide and online consultations. title: Japanese Law & Tax Services LP Hero

Use a wide horizontal web header layout. At the very top, place a large navy Japanese headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="あなたの『不安』に、確かな専門力で寄り添います。"}, and beneath it a smaller gold-accented Japanese subheadline reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="法律 × 税務のワンストップサポートで、最善の解決へ"}. Below the headline, arrange 4 equal vertical service cards side by side across the center. Card 3 is for inheritance tax, with a circular icon showing a house at the top, a warm gold color scheme, the title "相続税", supporting copy "円満な相続と、最適な税務対策をサポート", a tabletop scene with a model house, papers, and a calculator, and a mustard-gold bottom band listing exactly 2 bullet lines: "相続税の申告・節税対策" and "生前対策・事業承継支援". Card 4 is for divorce, with a circular icon showing a broken heart at the top, a rose-pink color scheme, the title "離婚", supporting copy "あなたの未来のために、納得できる解決を目指します", a soft professional consultation scene with a woman in a white blouse resting her hand near her chin while speaking across a desk, and a dusty-rose bottom band listing exactly 2 bullet lines: "親権・養育費・財産分与" and "離婚協議・調停・裁判対応". In the bottom area, add the firm identity on the left in Japanese: a small line "法律事務所・税理士事務所", a large firm name {argument name="firm name" default="架空総合法律税務事務所"}, and a smaller line "弁護士・税理士が連携するワンストップサービス". In the lower center, place 3 compact white feature boxes with navy line icons and short Japanese text: box 1 shows a group-of-people icon and says "各分野の専門家が対応", box 2 shows a handshake icon and says "相談者様に寄り添う親身なサポート", box 3 shows a document icon and says "初回相談60分無料". Add a small disclaimer beneath them: "※ご相談の内容によっては有料となる場合がございます。" On the lower right, create a prominent navy call-to-action panel with rounded corners. Include a small Japanese line "まずはお気軽にご相談ください", a large white phone number with phone icon {argument name="phone number" default="03-1234-5678"}, and a gold pill-shaped strip at the bottom reading {argument name="business hours" default="平日 9:00〜18:00（土日祝は事前予約で対応可）"}. title: Summer McCafé Mountain Road Ad
content: Create a premium vertical fast-food lifestyle advertisement in a polished commercial photography style, designed like a summer campaign poster for McDonald's and McCafé. Show a glamorous young woman with softly blurred, unidentifiable facial features sitting confidently on the hood of a sleek red sports car parked on a winding mountain road at golden hour. She has long wavy auburn hair glowing in warm sunset backlight, wears a dark green satin bomber jacket with gold detailing, a white camisole, high-waisted burgundy pants, and black ankle boots with heels. Her pose is relaxed and stylish, one leg bent and one extended forward, while she holds out a clear plastic cup of iced coffee with a straw and visible McDonald's golden arches branding toward the camera. Scatter red roses across the car hood around her, and place 1 McDonald's paper takeout bag on the right side of the hood. Use a dramatic canyon or hillside background with warm sunlight, soft haze, cinematic depth of field, and a luxurious aspirational road-trip mood. Include floating red flower petals in the air. Compose the layout as a high-end ad with the model centered slightly right and large promotional typography on the left. Add exactly 3 large headline lines in the upper left: "SIP.", "SAVOR.", and "{argument name="headline text" default="SUMMER."}" with the first 2 in bold white and the third in bold golden yellow. Below that, add the subheadline: "Refresh your drive with McCafé." with "McCafé" highlighted in yellow. Add exactly 3 circular feature icons stacked vertically on the left with short captions: "PREMIUM McCAFÉ ICED COFFEE", "WORLD FAMOUS FRIES", and "QUALITY YOU CAN TASTE". Place the McDonald's golden arches logo with the text "i'm lovin' it" in the top right. Add a small lower-left tagline reading "Good days start here." with "start here." in yellow. Create a bold yellow bottom banner spanning the width, divided into 3 content areas: left area reads "SUMMER SAVINGS" and "ENJOY EXCLUSIVE OFFERS"; center area includes a McDonald's app icon and the text "DOWNLOAD THE APP FOR DEALS NEAR YOU"; right area reads "FOLLOW US @MCDONALDS" with social icons. Use brand-accurate red and yellow accents, glossy product styling, realistic lighting, sharp editorial retouching, shallow depth of field, luxury commercial ad composition, and mobile-first poster proportions.

title: Anime Summer Street Poster
content: A high-energy vertical anime street poster inspired by a pirate adventure crew, designed like a stylish summer campaign key visual in a modern Japanese shopping street under a vivid blue sky with fluffy white clouds. Show exactly 8 characters grouped closely in the foreground and midground, all happily eating colorful ice cream cones while walking through the city. Center front: a young man in a wide straw hat, oversized red graphic T-shirt, blue shorts, and a black crossbody waist bag, holding a mint-blue ice cream cone. Front left: a green-haired young man in a black oversized graphic shirt with green lettering and layered necklaces, eating ice cream. Front right: a small chibi-like reindeer mascot character wearing a large pink hat with a white X, black and pink streetwear jacket, and holding a blue-and-pink ice cream cone. Right midground: a long-nosed smiling young man in a cap and casual streetwear, loudly laughing with an ice cream cone; behind him a tall skeleton man with a large black afro, crown-like hat, purple hoodie, sunglasses, and an ice cream cone. Left midground: an orange-haired young woman in a cropped white tank top and jeans holding ice cream; behind center-left a blond young man in a blue shirt with a relaxed pose and ice cream; center-right a dark-haired young woman in a purple outfit with sunglasses on her head holding ice cream. The mood is cheerful, summery, fashionable, and adventurous. Make the composition feel like a premium anime tourism or retail poster with dramatic perspective from street level, dense urban signage, shop windows, hanging signs, and branded poster panels. Add large brush-script title text across the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="ONE PIECE"} in huge white paint strokes, with a yellow handwritten subtitle reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="Straw Hat Crew"}. On the upper left, stack poster text blocks reading exactly: "STRAW HAT CREW", "2024", "WE GO! TOGETHER! NEW WORLD!". On the right side, add a vertical street sign reading "New World". Include a pink hanging sign reading "ICE CREAM" with a skull emblem. Add pirate-skull hat emblems in the corners and on storefront signage. At the lower left, place white handwritten script reading "Enjoy! Ice Cream" with a small smiley, and beneath it smaller bold text reading "一起去吃冰淇淋吧！". At the lower left edge add small text: "I'M GONNA BE KING OF THE PIRATES!". At the lower right add "ONE PIECE 2024", a barcode, and tiny caption text "STRAW HAT CREW SUMMER ICE CREAM". Use glossy anime illustration rendering, bold cel shading, crisp line art, rich fabric folds, detailed accessories, vibrant summer lighting, cinematic contrast, poster-grade typography, and a polished commercial key art finish. Aspect ratio 2:3 portrait.
description: This prompt generates a polished vertical anime-style ensemble poster of a pirate-themed friend group eating ice cream in a sunny city street, ideal for fan-art key visuals, event posters, and stylish promotional graphics.

content: Create a dramatic studio food advertisement poster on a dark black textured background with moody, high-contrast lighting and rich warm orange tones. The composition is vertical and split visually: bold stacked ad copy on the left, hero food action on the right. Show a deep rustic bowl overflowing with triangular cheddar corn chips in the lower center-right, with thick glossy cheese sauce being poured in a continuous stream from a tilted dark metal saucepan entering from the upper right. The cheese lands heavily on top of the chips and drapes over them in thick molten folds. Behind the bowl on the left, place 1 upright red snack bag with a large yellow-orange starburst graphic and the brand text {argument name="brand name" default="CRUNCHY CHIPZ"} in big white outlined letters, plus smaller flavor text {argument name="flavor text" default="ZESTY CHEDDAR"} and tiny subtitle "FLAVORED CORN SNACKS". Print tiny text near the lower left of the bag: "SAVORY TRIANGLES". Add 2 small condiment bowls on the dark tabletop: 1 shallow bowl of shredded cheddar in the bottom left corner and 1 tiny bowl of reddish seasoning near the bottom center-right. Scatter a few crumbs and cheese shreds across the table, with a dark napkin tucked under the main bowl. Include bold distressed condensed uppercase typography in a vintage poster style. On the upper left, stack the headline in 5 lines reading: {argument name="headline text" default="THE ULTIMATE MUNCH."} with "THE" on line 1, "ULTIMATE" on line 2, and "MUNCH." on line 3 in large type, followed by line 4 "EXPERIENCE" and line 5 "TRUE UMAMI." in smaller white text. Beneath that, add 2 promotional lines in orange: {argument name="review text" default="OVER 300 REVIEWS."}. In the bottom right, place a 3-line orange callout reading {argument name="tagline text" default="DIP, POUR, MUNCH."}. Use cinematic food photography styling, sharp focus on chips and cheese stream, appetizing glossy textures, commercial packaging realism, premium snack-brand ad aesthetic.
description: This prompt generates a bold commercial food poster for a cheesy corn chip brand, ideal for ads, packaging mockups, and social media promotions.

title: Fashion Height Comparison of Four Women
content: A clean fashion comparison studio photo of 4 adult East Asian women standing side by side against a plain light gray seamless background, full body visible from head to shoes, photographed straight-on with soft diffused lighting and a polished commercial look. Above each woman, centered over her head in black serif text, place height labels reading exactly: 145cm, 155cm, 165cm, 175cm. Emphasize realistic proportional differences in height while keeping all four women slim, elegant, and similarly styled, with long dark brown to black softly wavy hair and neutral expressions. Their faces are obscured by smooth rectangular blur blocks. The women stand very close together in a friendly pose, with subtle arm contact and one woman lightly resting an arm around another. Use a coordinated beige, cream, taupe, and soft blush wardrobe palette with smart casual feminine outfits and matching ivory loafers. Woman 1 under the 145cm label wears a short-sleeve cream ribbed knit top tucked into high-waisted light beige shorts with a fabric belt, plus a small quilted shoulder bag with a chain strap. Woman 2 under the 155cm label wears a white long-sleeve blouse with a bow tie at the collar and a taupe mini skirt with a slight flared hem, carrying a small light beige crossbody handbag. Woman 3 under the 165cm label wears a sleeveless blush-beige ribbed knit top and a simple ivory mini skirt. Woman 4 under the 175cm label wears a draped white V-neck blouse with sleeves rolled to the forearms, high-waisted taupe belted shorts, and a medium taupe shoulder bag. All 4 women wear cream or ivory horsebit loafers. Composition is vertical, centered, minimal, stylish, realistic, like a fashion catalog image comparing female heights.
description: This prompt generates a realistic studio fashion image showing four women of different labeled heights, useful for social media comparison posts or editorial-style visual guides.

title: Korean Rice Drink Parody Ad Poster
content:
Create a bold Korean-style beverage advertisement poster with a warm golden splash background and dramatic commercial lighting. Show a {argument name="celebrity spokesperson" default="Donald Trump-like older male politician"} from the chest up, wearing a navy suit, white dress shirt, bright red tie, and a small American flag lapel pin, facing camera with a confident sales-pitch expression. His face is obscured by a flat rectangular censor block in a skin-toned color. In his left hand, extended close to the camera in forced perspective, he holds a yellow aluminum can of Korean rice punch drink labeled prominently in Korean, with red top and bottom bands and the main product text "비락 식혜" and "Since 1993" on the can. The can also includes smaller Korean copy, an image of sweet rice drink near the bottom, and the volume text "238 ml (120 kcal)". His right hand gives a thumbs-up.

Use an energetic retro-commercial composition, with splashing sweet rice beverage and droplets behind him, glowing golden highlights, and a slightly low-angle heroic framing. At the top, include 3 distinct headline text groups: a small handwritten-style black slogan on the upper left reading "전통의 맛, 한국의 DRINK!", a huge central headline in distressed bold Korean type reading "걸죽는 땐?" in dark brown-black and "비락 식혜!" in vivid red, and a brand logo on the upper right reading "비락" with small red text "Since 1993" beneath it. Add 2 callout badges: on the left, a yellow circular seal with a tiny crown icon and the text "대한민국 국민음료 No.1"; on the right, a white speech bubble with handwritten Korean text "한국이 만든 맛있는 전통!" and red English text "I LOVE IT!".

At the bottom foreground, place 2 food elements: a brass bowl filled with sweet rice drink and floating rice grains on the left, and a wooden bowl piled with white rice on the right. Across the lower middle, add 2 lines of large brush-style promotional text, the first in white reading "달콤하게! 시원하게!" and the second in mixed white and yellow reading "속까지 시~원하게!" with an energetic yellow underline stroke. Along the very bottom, include 3 circular feature icons with captions in Korean: "국내산 쌀 엄선된 재료", "시원하게 갈증해소", and "부드러운 단맛 속 편한 식혜". In the lower right corner, add tiny disclaimer text "연출된 이미지입니다". Make the overall look glossy, exaggerated, funny, and convincing like a viral parody print ad.
description: This prompt generates a humorous, high-impact parody beverage advertisement poster featuring a famous politician-like spokesperson promoting a Korean canned rice drink.

title: Packaging Design Proposal Board Prompt
content:
Please generate a "hand-drawn packaging proposal board style" product introduction poster for {argument name="product name" default="milk powder"}.

If I provide a product image, please use it as the main reference, retaining the core visual characteristics, packaging form, colors, materials, brand identity, and overall temperament of the product. Prioritize the main color tone and color relationships from the product image for the design.
If I do not provide a product image, please automatically generate a product appearance and packaging design that fits the positioning of {argument name="product name" default="milk powder"}, and automatically match natural and reasonable main, auxiliary, and background colors based on the product attributes, category characteristics, and temperament.

Overall poster style requirements:
This is not a standard e-commerce detail page or a simple studio-shot poster, but a creative proposal board that integrates "product finished image + packaging design sketches + brand concept development process." The overall presentation is a high-aesthetic, high-completion brand design display image, as if a designer is presenting a packaging concept proposal.

Visual requirements:
- Vertical composition
- Use a unified background with a brand feel; the background color should be naturally determined by the product itself and not fixed to any one color.
- Color schemes should coordinate with product attributes: if there is a reference image, prioritize inheriting its main and brand colors; if not, automatically generate a reasonable color scheme based on the product name.
- Place the most complete and eye-catching product main visual in the center, with realistic textures, 3D lighting, and commercial finish effects.
- Surround the product with multiple auxiliary visual elements: packaging sketches from different angles, structural sketches, local form explorations, hand-held display drafts, packaging unfolding ideas, and brand lettering layout experiments.
- Add natural and casual black or dark hand-drawn line art, arrows, circles, symbols, and handwritten Chinese annotations to give the image a strong sense of "design process" and "creative proposal."
- The finished product image should be relatively refined and realistic, while the sketch parts should be relatively casual and dynamic, creating a contrast between the "finished product + design sketches."
- The layout should look relaxed and free, but overall it must have order, rhythm, and a visual center, reflecting a high-end graphic design feel.
- Small graphics, symbols, or interesting elements related to the product can be added appropriately to enhance brand memory points.
- The final effect should have a sense of branding, creativity, process, and visual impact.

Color principles:
- Do not fix a yellow background.
- Automatically select the main color tone based on product type, material, use, consumer experience, and brand temperament.
- The background color, product color, text color, and sketch line art color should coordinate with each other.
- High-saturation monochromatic backgrounds or soft, unified color schemes can be used, as long as the overall image has a brand feel and visual impact.
- Colors should naturally serve the product rather than overshadow it.

Style keywords:
Packaging design proposal board, brand concept development, hand-drawn sketches, design process feel, moodboard, creative review draft, product finished rendering, visual experimentation, commercial design poster.

Special notes:
- If there is a reference product image, prioritize following it and do not deviate from the product itself.
- If there is no reference image, automatically generate reasonable product appearance, packaging, and color schemes based on the product name, maintaining overall style consistency.
- The focus of the image is "product introduction + creative design process display."
- Do not make it look like a common e-commerce detail page, a promotional poster, or overly neat and stiff; do not lack sketches and handwritten annotations; avoid a cheap feel or an immature cartoon style.
description: A highly detailed prompt for creating professional hand-drawn style product packaging design proposals and conceptual mood boards.

title: Luxury x E-commerce Split Poster
content: Create a vertical 9:16 luxury-campaign poster for a fictional crossover product, a disruptive co-branded handbag advertisement between {argument name="brand one" default="HERMÈS PARIS"} and {argument name="brand two" default="拼多多"}. The composition is a violently split, collage-style fashion key visual with a torn-paper seam running vertically down the center, dividing two clashing aesthetics: on the left, refined premium luxury branding in warm Hermes orange, cream paper, and elegant editorial minimalism; on the right, aggressive Chinese e-commerce promotion energy in black and metallic red foil, with loud sale graphics, confetti, ripped stickers, and explosive discount typography. At the top center, place both brands prominently with a large collaboration headline in Chinese, the left logo area styled like a classic luxury house with serif typography and horse-and-carriage emblem, the right logo area in bold red Chinese branding. Below that, add the main headline text in huge Chinese characters: {argument name="headline text" default="颠覆性联名款"}, and a boxed subheadline: {argument name="subheadline text" default="百亿补贴铂金包"}. The centerpiece is one Birkin-style luxury handbag shown front-facing and large, perfectly centered but visually split in half along the torn seam: the left half is orange pebbled leather with gold hardware, the right half is crinkled metallic silver leather with silver hardware, both halves seamlessly merged into one surreal bag. The bag should include 5 clearly visible accessory/product elements around or on it: 1 orange clochette hanging on the left, 1 metallic silver hanging strap with lock on the right, 1 central turn-lock closure with padlock, 1 orange Hermes-style gift box with dark ribbon at lower left, and 1 beige dust bag with small logo near the bottom left. Behind the bag on the left is a painterly orange brushstroke on textured cream paper; behind the bag on the right is a crushed reflective red metallic wrapper surface with spark-like highlights and falling confetti. On the right half, add 8 aggressive promotional text bursts and stickers layered diagonally like an online shopping festival poster: 1 giant white Chinese slogan "百亿补贴 全网最低", 2 "限时秒杀!!", 3 a torn price sticker reading "补贴价 ¥999?!", 4 "万件疯抢", 5 "百亿补贴 官方直补", 6 "直降到底", 7 a large bottom torn banner repeating "补贴价 ¥999?!", and 8 small text "建议零售价 ¥1000000+". On the left margin, add a slim vertical editorial text column with 4 grouped text blocks in a luxury layout: 1 "限量发售 / 全球瞩目 / 2024 LIMITED EDITION", 2 "HERMÈS PARIS MADE IN FRANCE", 3 "CRAFTED FOR ELEGANCE", and 4 "DESIGNED TO DEFY THE ORDINARY". At the bottom, create a black app-like information bar with 3 feature blocks from left to right: 1 a red brand icon with "拼多多" and a search-bar style pill containing "百亿补贴铂金包", 2 a lightning icon with the text "百亿补贴 官方补贴 所以低价", and 3 a shield icon with the text "正品保障 假一赔十 3期免息". Add a thin final slogan line across the very bottom in small Chinese text. Use hyper-detailed commercial product photography, premium graphic design, sharp lighting, embossed textures, foil reflections, paper tears, and strong depth. The overall mood must feel like a world-class art director forced a heritage luxury campaign and a chaotic discount-shopping poster to collide in one image, producing extreme visual tension, irony, and high-impact contrast.
description: This prompt generates a high-impact vertical campaign poster that collides luxury fashion branding with chaotic discount-platform promotion for a provocative co-branded product ad.

title: Luxury Bag Meets Discount Chaos Poster
content: A vertical 9:16 luxury-fashion parody advertising poster with a single centered handbag as the hero product, designed as a brutal collision between ultra-premium maison branding and chaotic Chinese e-commerce discount graphics. title: Japanese Hospital Comedy DVD Cover

The cover shows a hospital room interior with soft beige walls, a bed, curtains on the right, and subtle medical fixtures in the background. In the center foreground, 1 seated young Japanese woman in a loose light-blue hospital gown sits on a bed, looking confused and vulnerable. Around her stand 3 young Japanese female medical staff: 2 nurses in pale pink uniforms with matching nurse caps and ID badges, and 1 doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope. Each of the 3 standing women is holding up a smartphone toward the camera, and each phone screen shows the seated woman’s face or body as if her consciousness has been transferred into their devices, creating a body-jack possession theme. The overall tone is playful, absurd, and slightly eerie, like a Japanese idol movie or hospital comedy DVD jacket. Below it, make the main title huge, rounded, glossy, and bubbly in pink and blue Japanese text: {argument name="main title" default="ボディジャック"}. Under the title, add a pink subtitle in Japanese: {argument name="subtitle" default="～私のカラダ、乗っ取られました～"}.
